PRINT IN PLACE FLEXI PARASAUROLOPHUS DINOSAUR ARTICULATED
Hey everyone, how are you all doing? Today, we have an exciting announcement for all you dinosaur lovers! We’re thrilled to introduce a new dinosaur from Toonzfactory's dinosaur lineup. Hello, everyone! I hope you're all doing well. Today, I've got something new for you that I think you're going to love. So, without further ado, let me present to you our new design - Flexi CopperHead Snake—a design that's bound to capture all your hearts. Get ready to fall in love with it!
We have created the Copperhead Snake in two versions: one without a tongue, and one with a tongue. In the second version, you can print the body and tongue separately and then glue them together.
The Copperhead Snake is known for its distinctive copper-colored head and patterned body, making it both striking and easily recognizable. It’s a venomous snake found primarily in North America, often blending into its surroundings with its natural camouflage. Despite its venom, it’s generally non-aggressive and will avoid confrontation if possible.
Now, moving on to the design itself -We've created this design in three parts: body, head, and tail. The body has two ball sockets where you can attach the head and tail, allowing you to print this design as large as you'd like. it's a print-in-place, no-supports, fully flexible design that you can easily print without any additional support. description_text:
English Description:The Realistic Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton Model is a scientifically accurate and meticulously detailed 3D representation of the iconic T-Rex fossil. Ideal for museum exhibits, educational animations, scientific visualizations, and dinosaur-themed projects, this model features every major bone structure including the massive skull, ribcage, spine, limbs, and tail with lifelike proportion and anatomical accuracy. Perfect for high-quality renders, VR simulations, or paleontology-focused media. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats for maximum compatibility with all major 3D platforms.
German Description:Das Realistic Tyrannosaurus Rex Skeleton Modell ist eine wissenschaftlich präzise und äußerst detaillierte 3D-Darstellung des ikonischen T-Rex-Skeletts. Ideal für Museumsausstellungen, Bildungsanimationen, wissenschaftliche Visualisierungen und Dinosaurier-Projekte. Das Modell umfasst alle wichtigen Knochenstrukturen – darunter der massive Schädel, Brustkorb, Wirbelsäule, Gliedmaßen und Schwanz – in lebensnaher Proportion und anatomischer Genauigkeit. Perfekt für hochwertige Renderings, VR-Simulationen oder paläontologische Medien. Verfügbar in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.
Polish Description:Realistyczny Model Szkieletu Tyranozaura Rex to szczegółowa i naukowo wierna reprezentacja 3D znanego szkieletu T-Rexa. Idealny do ekspozycji muzealnych, animacji edukacyjnych, wizualizacji naukowych oraz projektów o tematyce dinozaurów. Zawiera wszystkie główne struktury kostne, w tym czaszkę, klatkę piersiową, kręgosłup, kończyny i ogon, odwzorowane z zachowaniem realistycznych proporcji. Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND, kompatybilny z wszystkimi głównymi platformami 3D.
Arabic Description:نموذج هيكل عظمي واقعي للديناصور تي-ريكس هو تمثيل ثلاثي الأبعاد دقيق علميًا ومفصل للغاية للحفرية الشهيرة. مثالي للمعارض المتحفية، الرسوم المتحركة التعليمية، التصورات العلمية أو المشاريع التي تتناول الديناصورات. يشمل جميع أجزاء الهيكل الرئيسية مثل الجمجمة الكبيرة، القفص الصدري، العمود الفقري، الأطراف والذيل، مع دقة تشريحية كاملة. مناسب للعروض عالية الجودة، المحاكاة في الواقع الافتراضي أو الوسائط المتخصصة في علم الحفريات. متاح بصيغ FBX وOBJ وSTL وGLB وUSDZ وBLEND.
Chinese Description:真实版霸王龙骨骼模型是一款科学严谨且高度细节化的3D模型，再现了这只史前巨兽的化石结构。非常适合用于博物馆展示、教育动画、科学可视化以及恐龙主题项目。模型包括主要骨骼结构，如巨大头骨、肋骨、脊柱、四肢和尾巴，比例真实、结构准确。支持 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式，兼容所有主流3D平台。
Korean Description:리얼리스틱 티라노사우루스 렉스 골격 모델은 고생물학적으로 정확하고 정교하게 설계된 3D 공룡 화석 모델입니다. 박물관 전시, 교육용 애니메이션, 과학 시각화, 공룡 테마 콘텐츠에 이상적입니다. 거대한 두개골, 갈비뼈, 척추, 팔다리, 꼬리 등 주요 뼈 구조가 현실적인 비율과 해부학적 정확성을 바탕으로 구현되어 있습니다. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, BLEND 형식으로 제공되며 모든 주요 3D 플랫폼과 호환됩니다.
Turkish Description:Gerçekçi Tyrannosaurus Rex İskelet Modeli, ünlü T-Rex fosilinin bilimsel olarak doğru ve son derece detaylı bir 3D temsilidir. Müzeler, eğitim animasyonları, bilimsel görselleştirmeler ve dinozor temalı projeler için idealdir. Devasa kafatası, kaburga, omurga, uzuvlar ve kuyruk dahil tüm temel kemik yapıları gerçekçi oranda ve anatomik doğrulukla modellenmiştir. Yüksek kaliteli renderlar, VR simülasyonları veya paleontoloji odaklı medyalar için uygundur. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ ve BLEND formatlarında sunulur.
French Description:Le modèle réaliste du squelette de Tyrannosaurus Rex est une sculpture 3D d’une grande précision scientifique et riche en détails, représentant le célèbre fossile. Parfait pour les expositions muséales, animations éducatives, visualisations scientifiques ou projets sur le thème des dinosaures. Il comprend toutes les structures osseuses principales – crâne massif, cage thoracique, colonne vertébrale, membres et queue – avec des proportions fidèles et une anatomie exacte. Disponible aux formats FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ et BLEND.

description_text:
Inspired by prehistoric archaeological digs and everybody's favorite King Kaiju, Skullzilla features a fun and original design and the trendy flexi joint system beloved by customers. He has a wide range of motion at every joint, located at the neck, all four limbs, the torso, the hips, and three tail joints. He has a balanced equilibrium to allow for both a standing position and a tummy lying position.
I printed him to be 6 inches long when lying down, but you could feasibly print him smaller or larger, whatever you prefer. Settings are fairly standard. description_text:
Here is the NEWEST STL/3MF to the Gigantuan Design library, Kaijoo Deng, the loveable pygmy hippo kaiju!
She was originally a meme created by community content creator and Gigantuan Design ambassador @b1tchzilla on instagram, and I have been wanting a figure ever since. With her permission, I was able to turn this adorable meme into a physical print. I hope I did her justice!
Since this is a multicolor print, your mileage may vary. I printed this as a 4 color file, 6 inches long (that's 127mm), and it took me just under 9 hours to print on my X1C. I have included both a 4 color and 5 color file, the 5 color file including the pupils, which I just hand painted black. If you add a 5th color change, it may take longer. A one color print, of course, would probably take less than half the print time a 4 color would.
While this is a print in place, I do suggest manually adding supports under the chin. Do NOT autosupport, as it will try to support the joints, which will cause joint fusion and render poor Kaijoo Deng motionless.
Same standard print settings as usual. I printed it at .2 layer height, 15% infill, rectilinear infill (although gyroid would probably work as well), with manual supports UNDER THE CHIN ONLY and no brim. You could feasibly print this with a smaller layer height for detail reasons at the expense of adding print time.
I can't wait to see your Kaijoo Deng prints!

description_text:
Detailed 3D model of a Spinosaurus Skeleton. This model accurately represents the skeletal structure of Spinosaurus aegyptiacus, one of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs known for the distinctive sail-like structure on its back. The model showcases the key bones of a Spinosaurus skeleton, including the long skull with its narrow snout and conical teeth, the relatively short neck, the elongated neural spines forming the prominent sail along its back, the robust rib cage, the powerful forelimbs with large claws, the strong hindlimbs, and the long tail. The model incorporates current paleontological understanding, including potential adaptations for a semi-aquatic lifestyle. This 3D model is ideal for use in paleontology education, dinosaur-themed projects, museum exhibits (virtual or physical), scientific research, or any project requiring a detailed and accurate skeletal representation of Spinosaurus. The model is provided in multiple formats: FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of 3D software and platforms.

Bu model, sırtında kendine özgü yelken benzeri yapısıyla bilinen en büyük etçil dinozorlardan biri olan Spinosaurus aegyptiacus'un iskelet yapısını doğru bir şekilde temsil eder. French Description:
Modèle 3D détaillé d'un Squelette de Spinosaurus. Ce modèle représente avec précision la structure squelettique de Spinosaurus aegyptiacus, l'un des plus grands dinosaures carnivores connus pour la structure distinctive en forme de voile sur son dos. Le modèle met en évidence les os clés du squelette de Spinosaurus, y compris le long crâne avec son museau étroit et ses dents coniques, le cou relativement court, les épines neurales allongées formant la voile proéminente le long de son dos, la cage thoracique robuste, les membres antérieurs puissants avec de grandes griffes, les membres postérieurs forts et la longue queue. Le modèle intègre la compréhension paléontologique actuelle, y compris les adaptations potentielles à un mode de vie semi-aquatique. Ce modèle 3D est idéal pour une utilisation dans l'enseignement de la paléontologie, les projets sur le thème des dinosaures, les expositions muséales (virtuelles ou physiques), la recherche scientifique ou tout projet nécessitant une représentation squelettique détaillée et précise de Spinosaurus. Le modèle est fourni en plusieurs formats : FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ et BLEND, assurant la compatibilité avec une large gamme de logiciels et de plateformes 3D.

description_text:
Concise 3D model of a Draco Lizard gliding. Depicts a Draco lizard (also known as a flying lizard) in a gliding pose, with its patagia (wing-like membranes) extended. Showcases its flattened body and the colorful membranes supported by elongated ribs, allowing it to glide between trees in its Southeast Asian habitat. Known for its insectivorous diet. Suitable for wildlife, nature, Southeast Asian fauna, and educational visualizations. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.
İngilizce Anahtar Kelimeler:

Almanca Beschreibung:
Kurzes 3D-Modell eines gleitenden Drachenleguans. Zeigt einen Draco-Leguan (auch bekannt als Flugdrache) in einer Gleitpose, mit ausgebreiteten Patagia (flügelartigen Membranen). Präsentiert seinen abgeflachten Körper und die farbenprächtigen Membranen, die von verlängerten Rippen getragen werden und es ihm ermöglichen, in seinem südostasiatischen Lebensraum zwischen Bäumen zu gleiten. Bekannt für seine insektenfressende Ernährung. Geeignet für Visualisierungen von Wildtieren, Natur, südostasiatischer Fauna und für Bildungszwecke. Verfügbar in den Formaten FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.

Lehcze Opis:
Krótki model 3D Szybującego Latającego Smoka. Przedstawia latającego smoka (Draco) w pozycji szybującej, z rozpostartymi patagiami (błonami przypominającymi skrzydła). Ukazuje jego spłaszczone ciało i kolorowe błony podtrzymywane przez wydłużone żebra, co pozwala mu szybować między drzewami w jego środowisku naturalnym w Azji Południowo-Wschodniej. Znany z diety owadożernej. Nadaje się do wizualizacji dzikiej przyrody, natury, fauny Azji Południowo-Wschodniej i edukacyjnych. Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND.

نموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد موجز لسحلية التنين وهي تنزلق. يصور سحلية التنين (Draco) (المعروفة أيضًا باسم السحلية الطائرة) في وضعية انزلاق، مع فرد أغشيتها الجلدية (patagia) الشبيهة بالأجنحة. يعرض جسمها المسطح والأغشية الملونة المدعومة بأضلاع ممدودة، مما يسمح لها بالانزلاق بين الأشجار في موطنها بجنوب شرق آسيا. معروفة بنظامها الغذائي الحشري. مناسب لتصورات الحياة البرية والطبيعة والحيوانات في جنوب شرق آسيا والتعليمية. متوفر بتنسيقات FBX و OBJ و STL و GLB و USDZ و BLEND.

飞蜥滑翔的简洁 3D 模型。描绘了一只处于滑翔姿势的飞蜥 (Draco)，其翼膜（翼状膜）已展开。展示了其扁平的身体以及由细长的肋骨支撑的彩色膜，使其能够在东南亚栖息地的树木之间滑翔。以其食虫性饮食而闻名。适用于野生动物、自然、东南亚动物群和教育可视化。提供 FBX、OBJ、STL、GLB、USDZ 和 BLEND 格式。

description_text:
Güneşlenen Boynuzlu Kertenkele'nin kısa 3D modeli. Güneşlenirkenki bir Boynuzlu Kertenkele'nin (cins Phrynosoma) 3D temsilini tasvir eder. Boynuzlu kertenkeleler, yassı vücutları, dikenli pulları ve başlarındaki belirgin boynuzlarıyla bilinen bir Kuzey Amerika kertenkeleleri grubudur. Güneşlenme, kertenkelenin ısıyı emmek ve vücut sıcaklığını düzenlemek için güneşte yatması davranışıdır. Model, kertenkeleyi bir yüzeyin üzerinde düz bir şekilde yatarken, muhtemelen güneş ışığını en üst düzeye çıkaracak şekilde yönlendirilmiş olarak gösterecektir. Farklı pul türleri, genellikle çevreyle uyum sağlayan renklenme ve boynuzların boyutu ve şekli gibi detaylar görünür olmalıdır. Bu model, sürüngenler hakkında eğitim materyalleri, vahşi yaşam görselleştirmeleri, zoolojik çalışmalar ve doğal yaşam alanlarını (Kuzey ve Orta Amerika'nın kurak ve yarı kurak bölgeleri) tasvir eden sanal ortamlar için uygundur. FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ ve BLEND formatlarında mevcuttur.

İngilizce Açıklama:
Concise 3D model of a Horned Lizard basking. Depicts a Horned Lizard (genus Phrynosoma) in a basking pose. Known for their flattened bodies, spiky scales, and prominent horns, horned lizards bask in the sun to regulate their body temperature. The model showcases the lizard lying flat on a surface, likely oriented to maximize sun exposure. Details such as the various types of scales, the camouflage coloration, and the size and shape of the horns are visible. Suitable for educational materials about reptiles, wildlife visualizations, zoological studies, and virtual environments depicting their natural habitat (arid and semi-arid regions of North and Central America). Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.

Almanca Beschreibung:
Kurzes 3D-Modell eines sonnenbadenden Hornleguans. Zeigt einen Hornleguan (Gattung Phrynosoma) in einer sonnenbadenden Pose. Hornleguane sind bekannt für ihren abgeflachten Körper, ihre stacheligen Schuppen und ihre markanten Hörner. Sie sonnen sich, um ihre Körpertemperatur zu regulieren. Das Modell zeigt die Eidechse flach auf einer Oberfläche liegend, wahrscheinlich so ausgerichtet, dass die Sonneneinstrahlung maximiert wird. Details wie die verschiedenen Arten von Schuppen, die Tarnfärbung sowie Größe und Form der Hörner sind sichtbar. Geeignet für Bildungsmaterialien über Reptilien, Wildtier-Visualisierungen, zoologische Studien und virtuelle Umgebungen, die ihren natürlichen Lebensraum (trockene und halbtrockene Regionen Nord- und Mittelamerikas) darstellen. Verfügbar in den Formaten FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ und BLEND.

Lehcze Opis:
Krótki model 3D Wygrzewającej się Rogatej Jaszczurki. Przedstawia jaszczurkę rogatą (rodzaj Phrynosoma) w pozie wygrzewania się na słońcu. Rogate jaszczurki, znane z płaskich ciał, kolczastych łusek i charakterystycznych rogów, wygrzewają się na słońcu, aby regulować temperaturę ciała. Model ukazuje jaszczurkę leżącą płasko na powierzchni, prawdopodobnie skierowaną tak, aby zmaksymalizować ekspozycję na słońce. Widoczne są detale takie jak różne rodzaje łusek, kamuflażowe ubarwienie oraz rozmiar i kształt rogów. Nadaje się do materiałów edukacyjnych o gadach, wizualizacji dzikiej przyrody, badań zoologicznych oraz do wirtualnych środowisk przedstawiających ich naturalne siedliska (pustynne i półpustynne regiony Ameryki Północnej i Środkowej). Dostępny w formatach FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ i BLEND.

description_text: This Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package is based on the Aegean Greek Fisherman’s cap. This cap is renowned for its iconic look. It’s been called a fiddler cap, a Mao cap as well as s Breton cap. The style is usually worn in black, navy blue wool or tan corduroy. Our Greek Fisherman’s Hat is fully customizable with multiple color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package can be used in a variety of programs. Images created in Cinema 4D and Marmoset Toolbag. Figure and lighting set not included. I’ve included the file formats:• 3DS• OBJ (medium, high)• FBX • MAX• STL• ZTL • C4D• 3D COATThe package offers three color styles; black, navy blue and tan. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:• Diffuse• Normal• Fresnel• Reflectance• RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The Greek Fisherman’s Hat Package models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

description_text:
This Safari Hat Package is based on the headwear that hunters and fishermen wear when they head out into the woods. The hat is perfect for men and women.  This asset is perfect for leisure time characters or 3D printing enthusiasts.Our Safari Hat Package is fully customizable. The template included in the package allows you to add your own custom color options. It was designed for a standard height figure (186 cm) in Cinema 4D and Zbrush. This package is ideal for game assets, illustration, and animation. It’s sized for standard figures in Unity, Poser or Daz Studio. I’ve broken the model down into its basic components for ease of customization. This Safari Hat Package can be used in a variety of programs. I’ve included the file formats:

  - 3DS

  - DFX

  - OBJ (medium, high)

  - FBX 

  - MAX

  - STL

  - ZTL 

  - C4D

  - 3D COATThe package offers textures and two obj files. The mesh comes in high and medium polygon options to fit your needs. The 3DS Max version and the Cinema 4D version allow for mesh smoothing. Textures are included in 2048x2048 for clear resolution. The package includes the following maps:

  - Diffuse

  - Normal

  - Fresnel

  - Reflectance

  - RoughnessThe package is presented in zip format. This requires an unzipping tool which most computers have as standard application. Use the appropriate format into your favorite 3D modeling program and customize the textures. The TEX folder contains the textures that come with these models.The Safari Hat Package models come pre-UV mapped along with a handy bitmap template from which to layout your own textures. Feel free to drop your suggestions to me for both realistic and fantasy style headgear.Be sure to check out the other models in my gallery. I’m always adding more models, so check back regularly; just click on my user name.

This is an art piece created by me. I have taken inspiration from deep-sea creatures among other this to produce this stylized fish model for everyone to enjoy. 
The model size is 120mmH x   150mmL x 113mmD (completed model on the base).

description_text:
The octopus (plural octopuses) is a soft-bodied, eight-limbed mollusc of the order Octopoda (/ɒkˈtɒpədə/, ok-TO-pə-də). Around 300 species are recognised, and the order is grouped within the class Cephalopoda with squids, cuttlefish, and nautiloids. Like other cephalopods, the octopus is bilaterally symmetric with two eyes and a beak, with its mouth at the center point of the eight limbs (tentacle is used as an umbrella term for cephalopod limbs; however, within a teuthological context, arm is used to refer to such limbs while tentacle is reserved for feeding appendages not found on octopuses). The soft body can rapidly alter its shape, enabling octopuses to squeeze through small gaps. They trail their eight appendages behind them as they swim. The siphon is used both for respiration and for locomotion, by expelling a jet of water. Octopuses have a complex nervous system and excellent sight, and are among the most intelligent and behaviourally diverse of all invertebrates.
Octopuses inhabit various regions of the ocean, including coral reefs, pelagic waters, and the seabed; some live in the intertidal zone and others at abyssal depths. Most species grow quickly, mature early, and are short-lived. In most species, the male uses a specially adapted arm to deliver a bundle of sperm directly into the female's mantle cavity, after which he becomes senescent and dies, while the female deposits fertilised eggs in a den and cares for them until they hatch, after which she also dies. Strategies to defend themselves against predators include the expulsion of ink, the use of camouflage and threat displays, the ability to jet quickly through the water and hide, and even deceit. All octopuses are venomous, but only the blue-ringed octopuses are known to be deadly to humans.
Octopuses appear in mythology as sea monsters like the Kraken of Norway and the Akkorokamui of the Ainu, and probably the Gorgon of ancient Greece. A battle with an octopus appears in Victor Hugo's book Toilers of the Sea, inspiring other works such as Ian Fleming's Octopussy. Octopuses appear in Japanese art, shunga. They are eaten and considered a delicacy by humans in many parts of the world, especially the Mediterranean and the Asian seas.

description_text:
A boat is a watercraft of a large range of types and sizes, but generally smaller than a ship, which is distinguished by its larger size, shape, cargo or passenger capacity, or its ability to carry boats.
Small boats are typically found on inland waterways such as rivers and lakes, or in protected coastal areas. However, some boats, such as the whaleboat, were intended for use in an offshore environment. In modern naval terms, a boat is a vessel small enough to be carried aboard a ship. Anomalous definitions exist, as lake freighters 1,000 feet (300 m) long on the Great Lakes are called boats.
Boats vary in proportion and construction methods with their intended purpose, available materials, or local traditions. Canoes have been used since prehistoric times and remain in use throughout the world for transportation, fishing, and sport. Fishing boats vary widely in style partly to match local conditions. Pleasure craft used in recreational boating include ski boats, pontoon boats, and sailboats. House boats may be used for vacationing or long-term residence. Lighters are used to convey cargo to and from large ships unable to get close to shore. Lifeboats have rescue and safety functions.
Boats can be propelled by manpower (e.g. rowboats and paddle boats), wind (e.g. sailboats), and motor (including gasoline, diesel, and electric).

description_text:
The Merlion (/ˈmɜːrˌlaɪən/) is the official mascot of Singapore. It is depicted as a mythical creature with the head of a lion and the body of a fish
Merlion[1] (English Merlion, Kit. trad. 魚尾獅, upr. 鱼尾狮, pinyin Yúwěishī, Malay. Singa-Laut, also found transcription Merlion) is a symbol of Singapore, a mythical creature with the body of a fish and the head of a lion. The word Merlion is formed from the words mer (sea, cf. mermaid — mermaid) and lion (lion).[2] The lion symbolizes strength and fearlessness, while Merlion's fish body emphasizes Singapore's close connection with the sea. The name of the city comes from the Sanskrit words singa (lion) and pura (city), as according to one of the legends, the name of the city was given by Prince Sang Nila Utama, who met a lion in the jungle. The prince took out his sword and prepared for battle, but after looking into each other's eyes, the lion and the prince parted in peace without harming each other.
The statue of Merlion in Singapore is based on the emblem of the city, designed in 1964 by Fraser Brunner commissioned by the Singapore Tourism Board. The 8.6-meter-high and 70-ton concrete statue is installed at the mouth of the Singapore River. On September 15, 1972, the opening ceremony of Merlion Park was held, attended by the Prime Minister of Singapore Lee Kuan Yew. On Sentosa Island, there is a 37-meter replica of the original statue in the recreation park.

Cage changed his name early in his career to make his own reputation, succeeding brilliantly with a host of classic, quirky roles by the late 1980s.
Initially studying theatre at Beverly Hills High School (though he dropped out at seventeen), he secured a bit part in Fast Times at Ridgemont High (1982) -- most of which was cut, dashing his hopes and leading to a job selling popcorn at the Fairfax Theater, thinking that would be the only route to a movie career. description_text:
The model of this dish contains 66312 triangles **and 33793 **vertices.
This project has two texture atlases and each has two textures: base color and normal.All other information you can get from the screenshots or mail me.
Bisi bele bath (Sambar Rice) is a popular lunch item in Karnataka. Bisi bele bath is widely available in most restaurants across the state. Bisi bele bath is good to have any time of the day- for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
Rice & Lentil (edible legume or dal) are cooked separately and mixed along with Bisi Bele Bath Masala or powder. This mix is heated for several minutes and stirred regularly to ensure consistency. Bisi Bele Bath masala can be made at home or purchased from stores. Bisi Bele Bath powder is made from fine grinding of chili, cloves, cumin, chana (Bengal gram), cinnamon, coconut, urad dal, coriander seeds and other ingredients. Vegetables such as drumstick, beans, capsicum and chopped carrots are often added to Bisi Bele Bath for enhanced taste.

description_text:
The Udaloy class, Russian designations Project 1155 Fregat and Project 11551 Fregat-M (Russian: Фрегат, 'Fregat' meaning Frigate), are series of anti-submarine guided missile destroyers built for the Soviet Navy, seven of which are currently in service with the Russian Navy. Twelve ships were built between 1980 and 1991, while the thirteenth ship built to a modified design, known as Udaloy II class, followed in 1999. They complement the Sovremenny-class destroyers in anti-aircraft and anti-surface warfare operations. The codename Udaloy comes from an archaic Russian adjective удалой, meaning daring or bold.
La classe Udaloy , désignations russes Project 1155 Fregat et Project 11551 Fregat-M ( russe : Фрегат , «Fregat» signifiant frégate), sont des séries de destroyers anti-sous-marins construits pour la marine soviétique, dont sept sont actuellement en service avec la marine russe. Douze navires ont été construits entre 1980 et 1991, tandis que le treizième navire construit selon une conception modifiée, connue sous le nom de classe Udaloy II, a suivi en 1999. Ils complètent les destroyers de classe Sovremenny dans les opérations de guerre anti-aérienne et anti-surface. Le nom de code Udaloy vient d'un adjectif russe archaïque удалой, signifiant audacieux ou audacieux.
La classe Udaloy, designazioni russe Project 1155 Fregat e Project 11551 Fregat-M (in russo: Фрегат, 'Fregat' che significa fregata), sono serie di cacciatorpediniere missilistici guidati anti-sottomarino costruiti per la Marina sovietica, sette dei quali sono attualmente in servizio con la marina russa. Dodici navi furono costruite tra il 1980 e il 1991, mentre la tredicesima nave costruita secondo un progetto modificato, nota come classe Udaloy II, seguì nel 1999. Completano i cacciatorpediniere di classe Sovremenny nelle operazioni di guerra antiaerea e anti-superficie. Il nome in codice Udaloy deriva da un aggettivo russo arcaico удалой, che significa audace o audace.
La clase Udaloy, designaciones rusas Proyecto 1155 Fregat y Proyecto 11551 Fregat-M (en ruso: Фрегат, 'Fregat' que significa Fragata), son una serie de destructores de misiles guiados antisubmarinos construidos para la Armada soviética, siete de los cuales están actualmente en servicio con la armada rusa. Se construyeron doce barcos entre 1980 y 1991, mientras que el decimotercer barco construido con un diseño modificado, conocido como clase Udaloy II, siguió en 1999. Complementan a los destructores de clase Sovremenny en operaciones de guerra antiaérea y antisuperficie. El nombre en clave Udaloy proviene de un adjetivo ruso arcaico удалой, que significa atrevido o audaz.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
River-dwelling creatures from japanese folklore.  The name roughly translates to water child or water sprite. Mischievous and malevolent, Kappa were nimble as fish in water but clumsy on land. In fact they carried water from their home river in their bowl-shaped heads, and should the water spill or run out, the Kappa was rendered unable to move at all.
I don't know about you, but from an RPG perspective I think that has huge potential in terms of game mechanics.
This model pack contains 19 unique models (sorry for the typo in the front page image), plus some pond-themed miniature bases. The models are intended for print at 28mm scale. As far as structural integrity goes most models should be printable at smaller scales as well, but details will suffer.
Use the model lineup image, or the images of individual models, to see a visual presentation of all included models.

description_text:
Ants are eusocial insects of the family Formicidae and, along with the related wasps and bees, belong to the order Hymenoptera. Ants appear in the fossil record across the globe in considerable diversity during the latest Early Cretaceous and early Late Cretaceous, suggesting an earlier origin. Ants evolved from vespoid wasp ancestors in the Cretaceous period, and diversified after the rise of flowering plants. More than 12,500 of an estimated total of 22,000 species have been classified. They are easily identified by their elbowed antennae and the distinctive node-like structure that forms their slender waists.
Ants form colonies that range in size from a few dozen predatory individuals living in small natural cavities to highly organised colonies that may occupy large territories and consist of millions of individuals. Larger colonies consist of various castes of sterile, wingless females, most of which are workers (ergates), as well as soldiers (dinergates) and other specialised groups. Nearly all ant colonies also have some fertile males called drones (aner) and one or more fertile females called queens (gynes). The colonies are described as superorganisms because the ants appear to operate as a unified entity, collectively working together to support the colony.
File:Blackants-bredcrust-tokyo-may2015.webm(video) Ants gathering foodAnts have colonised almost every landmass on Earth. The only places lacking indigenous ants are Antarctica and a few remote or inhospitable islands. Ants thrive in most ecosystems and may form 15–25% of the terrestrial animal biomass. Their success in so many environments has been attributed to their social organisation and their ability to modify habitats, tap resources, and defend themselves. Their long co-evolution with other species has led to mimetic, commensal, parasitic, and mutualistic relationships.
Ant societies have division of labour, communication between individuals, and an ability to solve complex problems. These parallels with human societies have long been an inspiration and subject of study. Many human cultures make use of ants in cuisine, medication, and rituals. Some species are valued in their role as biological pest control agents. Their ability to exploit resources may bring ants into conflict with humans, however, as they can damage crops and invade buildings. Some species, such as the red imported fire ant (Solenopsis invicta), are regarded as invasive species, establishing themselves in areas where they have been introduced accidentally.

The 3D model  is 3D printable.The laser cut version will be uploaded soon.There is also a keyshot rendering file containing the texture.Overview:The Yokosuka K5Y (九三式中間練習機, Kyūsanshikichūkanrenshūki, Type 93 Intermediate Training Aircraft, Allied reporting name: Willow) was a two-seat unequal-span biplane trainer that served in the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. Due to its bright orange paint scheme (applied to all Japanese military trainers for visibility), it earned the nickname aka-tombo, or red dragonfly, after a type of insect common throughout Japan.
A K5Y of the Kamikaze Special Attack Corps 3rd Ryuko Squadron was credited with sinking the destroyer USS Callaghan on July 29, 1945, the last US warship lost to kamikaze attack during the war.The aircraft was based on the Yokosuka Navy Type 91 Intermediate Trainer, but stability problems led to a redesign by Kawanishi in 1933. It entered service in 1934 as Navy Type 93 Intermediate Trainer K5Y1 with fixed tail-skid landing gear, and remained in use throughout the war. Floatplane types K5Y2 and K5Y3 were also produced. After the initial 60 examples by Kawanishi, production was continued by Watanabe (556 aircraft built), Mitsubishi (60), Hitachi (1,393), First Naval Air Technical Arsenal (75), Nakajima (24), Nippon (2,733), and Fuji (896), for a total of 5,770. These aircraft were the mainstay of Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service's flight training, and as intermediate trainers, they were capable of performing demanding aerobatic maneuvers. Two further land-based versions, the K5Y4 with a 358 kW (480 hp) Amakaze 21A engine and the K5Y5 with a 384 kW (515 hp) Amakaze 15, were projected but never built.

description_text:
Round Cork Coaster Stencil
Hi Everyone,
I designed these stencils to clip onto a round cork coaster (100mm) so you don't have to worry about the stencil moving around.
To use: Easily make tile coasters with these stencils. Simply paint the background that you want (wait for it to dry). 
Then clip one these stencils over the top. To add to you design and wallop you’re done!
The stencil maybe a little hard to get off, so gently pull up the corners in order to get them off.
If you want them bigger simply enlarge them in your slicer program.
• Please note that if you make them smaller you may lose details of the stencil,
• Please check your slicer program preview and check your layers. As the cutter maybe      better if it is resized bigger.• Print times will vary depending on your settings
Care: • Wash in cold soap water to keep them clean.• Do not put in hot water or it will warp• Do not place stencil in hot areas/ direct sunlight or it will warp
The stencil size is 101mmx101mm

The pendant is often crafted from precious metals like sterling silver, gold, or stainless steel, to honor the historical and religious significance of the symbol. Some designs may incorporate additional embellishments or gemstones to accentuate the sword's importance and add a touch of elegance.
The Zulfiqar sword holds deep symbolism within Islamic culture, representing valor, strength, and righteousness. It is also associated with the Battle of Karbala and the martyrdom of Imam Hussain, making it a poignant and revered symbol for many Muslims.
Wearing a Zulfiqar sword pendant is a display of devotion and respect for the teachings and values upheld by Imam Ali and his family, particularly Imam Hussain. It serves as a constant reminder of the courage to stand up against injustice and oppression, making it a cherished and meaningful piece for those who hold their faith close to their hearts.

description_text:
Jelly Candy Molding - Gummy Mould05 files included in this pack, as shown in second image:Base Model, x1 Negative, x1 Positive, x8 Negative, x8 Positive.

  - The base model is just a demo of the final candy

  - The negative pieces can be used directly as molds

  - The positive pieces can be used to create negative silicon molds

These molds can be used for jelly candies, chocolate, fondant, and any other material you'd like to try as a common mold.
I can create customized moldings, so feel free to contact me about it.
The sizes are pre-set small (usually around 20mm the final single candy) but you can resize all the molds as you'd like, quality won't change if you resize it bigger or smaller.Quality will change only based on your printer.
IMPORTANT: if you use the 3d printed model directly for candy, be aware if the material you use can have contact with foods.
Easy Printing (one side is full flat)No Support Required
Didn't test print it, but if I did, I would use this Cura settings on my Ender 3 Pro, printing in PLA:-Dynamic Quality: 0.16mm (or 0.12mm)-Printing Temperature: 200 (230 for V-Silk)-Build Plate Temperature: 70-Speed: 35 mm/s-Build Plate Adhesion Type: BrimBut feel free to change and use the settings you prefer.
I would highly recommend printing on Resin if you want high details in small pieces.

The Black Widow 3D Model: A Detailed OverviewThe Black Widow 3D model is a stunning representation of a deadly yet captivating arachnid, designed with meticulous attention to detail and realism. This lifelike model serves not only as a visual spectacle but also as a valuable educational tool and a testament to the advancements in 3D modeling technology.
The Design ProcessCreating the Black Widow 3D model involves a multi-faceted design process that begins with intensive research into the anatomy and behavior of black widows. Each segment of the spider, from its sleek black exoskeleton to its distinctive red hourglass marking, is painstakingly recreated to mirror its real-life counterpart accurately.
The intricate design work extends to the spider's eight legs, each joint and hair meticulously crafted to achieve a lifelike appearance. The designer pays close attention to the way light interacts with the spider's body, ensuring that the final 3D model is as realistic as possible.
Educational ValueBeyond its visual appeal, the Black Widow 3D model serves an important educational purpose. Schools, museums, and other educational institutions can utilize this model to teach students about arachnids, their role in the ecosystem, and the unique characteristics of black widows specifically.
By allowing viewers to explore the model from every angle, educators can offer a hands-on learning experience that enhances understanding and retention. Additionally, the detailed accuracy of the model provides a valuable reference for studying the anatomy of black widows in depth.
Technological AdvancementsThe creation of the Black Widow 3D model showcases the cutting-edge capabilities of modern 3D modeling technology. Advanced software tools enable designers to sculpt intricate details with precision, bringing virtual creations to life with unprecedented realism.
Moreover, the Black Widow model demonstrates the potential for 3D printing technology to revolutionize the production of educational materials. With the ability to reproduce highly detailed models quickly and efficiently, 3D printing opens up new possibilities for creating interactive learning resources.
In conclusion, the Black Widow 3D model stands as a testament to the intersection of art, science, and technology. Its stunning accuracy and educational value make it a valuable asset for both learning institutions and enthusiasts of 3D art. With its lifelike representation of one of nature's most intriguing creatures, this model invites viewers to appreciate the beauty and complexity of the natural world in a whole new dimension.

description_text:
This piece is representative of a themed Centipede Arcade Cabinet.
Centipede is a 1981 fixed shooter arcade video game developed and published by Atari, Inc. Designed by Dona Bailey and Ed Logg, it was one of the most commercially successful games from the golden age of arcade video games and one of the first with a significant female player base. 
The primary objective is to shoot all the segments of a centipede that winds down the playing field.
This is a 2 piece set, composed of the arcade cabinet itself and it's base. I've shown an example in the pictures how we can light up this piece, but take into consideration that we can use the light according to your own creativity (different colors, intensity, position, etc.).
Behind the piece you will find a small hole just in case you want to use a light source with a cord (e.g. LED strip).
The arcade cabinet dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 215
Width- 96
Depth- 90
The base of the arcade cabinet dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 8
Width- 96
Depth- 79
Sculpting software used: Blender
Render method used for the previews: Cycles
Filament: PLA
Slicer used to 3D print: Ultimaker Cura
Settings I've used to 3D print:
Standard quality - 0.2mm
Infill - 99%
Supports - I've used regular supports for the control panel (joystick with buttons) and for the top of the arcade (inner supports).
Speed - 50% first 20 layers and 100% for the rest
Plate Adhesion - Skirt

The Scarabs Model is a 3D representation of a group of scarab beetles, designed to create a creepy and unsettling atmosphere. These insects are highly detailed, with intricately textured bodies, including their distinctive shiny exoskeletons and segmented legs. Their horns and antennae add a menacing look, making them appear even more ominous. Typically associated with ancient Egypt, scarabs often symbolize rebirth and protection, but in this model, they are portrayed in a more sinister light. The swarm of scarabs can be modeled in various poses, such as crawling across surfaces or clustered together. This model is perfect for horror or adventure-themed projects, games, animations, or even for use in historical or archaeological settings.

Space Ship
This 3D render showcases a highly detailed futuristic spaceship with an intricate and sleek design. The ship features a dark metallic body, giving it a polished and formidable appearance. At its center, there is a cockpit-like structure with an ominous, hollow interior, suggesting a pilot or control hub. The smooth curvature of the main body is contrasted by sharp, angular extensions resembling wings, which add to its aerodynamic aesthetic. These wings are accented with vibrant cyan or electric blue panels, creating a striking contrast against the dark base color and enhancing its futuristic appeal.
The wings spread symmetrically on either side, resembling the structure of insect wings or a bird in flight, giving the impression of agility and speed. The extensions have segmented, geometric details, emphasizing advanced technology or an alien-like design philosophy. At the lower part of the spaceship, two elongated appendages resembling landing gear or stabilizers extend downward, reinforcing the vessel’s versatility in both flight and stationary modes.
The background features a shimmering, turquoise water surface that contrasts beautifully with the spaceship's mechanical and industrial appearance. The reflection of light on the water adds depth and realism to the scene, hinting that the ship might be hovering above an ocean or a similar environment.
Overall, this spaceship render combines elements of science fiction, advanced engineering, and organic design inspiration. The use of bold colors, geometric detailing, and sleek materials gives it a dynamic presence that could belong in a cutting-edge video game, sci-fi film, or concept art portfolio. The model demonstrates both artistic creativity and technical prowess, emphasizing a futuristic vision of space travel and exploration.

description_text:
Detailed 3D model of a Butterfly Exoskeleton (often referred to as a Butterfly Skeleton in a conceptual sense). This model accurately represents the external skeletal structure of a butterfly, an insect known for its delicate wings and vibrant colors. The model will showcase the key components of the butterfly's exoskeleton, including the head with its antennae and proboscis (in a coiled or extended state), the thorax with attachment points for the wings and legs, the segmented abdomen, and the intricate veined structure of the wings. The model will emphasize the lightweight yet sturdy nature of this external frame. This 3D model is ideal for use in biology education, entomology studies, scientific visualizations, artistic interpretations, or any project requiring a detailed anatomical representation of a butterfly's exoskeleton. The model is provided in multiple formats: FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of 3D software and platforms.

Whether you're a game developer, designer, animator, or 3D printing enthusiast, this versatile asset will meet your creative needs with efficiency and realism.
GermanDieses hochwertige 3D-Modell ist für eine Vielzahl digitaler Anwendungen geeignet – darunter Spiele, Animationen, Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), 3D-Druck und Produktvisualisierung. Es wird in den gängigen Formaten FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL und BLEND bereitgestellt und ist mit den meisten 3D-Programmen wie Blender, Unity und Unreal Engine kompatibel. Ganz gleich, ob Sie Entwickler, Designer, Animator oder 3D-Druck-Enthusiast sind – dieses Modell wird Ihre kreativen Anforderungen erfüllen.
TurkishBu yüksek kaliteli 3D model; oyunlar, animasyonlar, sanal gerçeklik (VR), artırılmış gerçeklik (AR), 3D baskı ve ürün görselleştirme gibi çeşitli dijital uygulamalarda kullanılmak üzere hazırlanmıştır. FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL ve BLEND gibi popüler dosya formatlarında sunulmakta olup Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine gibi çoğu 3D yazılımla uyumludur. İster oyun geliştiricisi, ister tasarımcı, animatör ya da 3D baskı tutkunu olun, bu model ihtiyaçlarınıza etkili ve gerçekçi bir çözüm sunacaktır.
FrenchCe modèle 3D de haute qualité est conçu pour une utilisation dans de nombreuses applications numériques telles que les jeux vidéo, l’animation, la réalité virtuelle (VR), la réalité augmentée (AR), l’impression 3D et la visualisation de produits. Il est fourni dans plusieurs formats populaires : FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL et BLEND, garantissant une compatibilité avec la plupart des logiciels 3D tels que Blender, Unity et Unreal Engine. Que vous soyez développeur de jeux, designer, animateur ou passionné d'impression 3D, ce modèle répondra à vos besoins créatifs.
Korean이 고품질 3D 모델은 게임, 애니메이션, 가상현실(VR), 증강현실(AR), 3D 프린팅 및 제품 시각화 등 다양한 디지털 용도에 적합하게 제작되었습니다. FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND 형식으로 제공되며 Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine 등 대부분의 3D 소프트웨어와 호환됩니다. 게임 개발자, 디자이너, 애니메이터 또는 3D 프린팅 애호가에게 적합한 다용도 리소스입니다.
Japaneseこの高品質な3Dモデルは、ゲーム、アニメーション、バーチャルリアリティ（VR）、拡張現実（AR）、3Dプリント、製品ビジュアライゼーションなど、さまざまなデジタル用途に適しています。FBX、OBJ、GLB、USDZ、STL、BLEND形式で提供されており、Blender、Unity、Unreal Engineなどの主要な3Dソフトウェアに対応しています。ゲーム開発者、デザイナー、アニメーター、または3Dプリント愛好者に最適です。
Chinese (Simplified)本高质量3D模型适用于游戏、动画、虚拟现实（VR）、增强现实（AR）、3D打印以及产品可视化等多种数字化场景。模型支持主流格式：FBX、OBJ、GLB、USDZ、STL、BLEND，兼容Blender、Unity、Unreal Engine等各类3D软件。无论您是游戏开发者、设计师、动画师还是3D打印爱好者，这款模型都能满足您的创作需求。
PolishTen wysokiej jakości model 3D doskonale sprawdzi się w wielu zastosowaniach cyfrowych – takich jak gry, animacje, rzeczywistość wirtualna (VR), rozszerzona rzeczywistość (AR), druk 3D czy wizualizacje produktów. Arabicهذا النموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد عالي الجودة مناسب لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات الرقمية مثل الألعاب، الرسوم المتحركة، الواقع الافتراضي (VR)، الواقع المعزز (AR)، الطباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، وتصور المنتجات. يتم توفيره بصيغ متعددة شهيرة: FBX وOBJ وGLB وUSDZ وSTL وBLEND، مما يجعله متوافقًا مع معظم برامج النمذجة مثل Blender وUnity وUnreal Engine. سواء كنت مطور ألعاب، مصممًا، رسامًا متحركًا أو هاوي طباعة ثلاثية الأبعاد، فإن هذا النموذج سيلبي احتياجاتك الإبداعية بكفاءة.

The ladybug is depicted with its characteristic round or oval body, typically bright red or orange with black spots. The model will show details such as its small head, antennae, six legs tucked underneath its body, and its distinctive elytra (wing cases) with the iconic spotted pattern. The pose suggests the ladybug is either stationary on a surface, such as a leaf or stem, or preparing to take flight. This 3D model is ideal for use in nature scenes, educational materials about insects, children's animations, game environments, or any project requiring a detailed and realistic representation of a ladybug. You can use it as a normal mold or use these tools in a housing to create a silicon moldFor artesansCan be used to create models of: EVA, Foam, Craft, Silicone, Chocolate, etc - but mostly for artificial flower arrangements/decorations/etc

  - Male Piece (Positive)

  - Female Piece (negative)You can press one against the other to create a moldOr you can use male piece to create a template/housing for a silicon mold

description_text:
Robot Bee is a flexi, articulated print in place (95%) model inspired by a bee. It has a flexi abdomen, latching hinged knee joints, ball hinge hip joints, ball and socket neck joint and snap in ball joint wing connectors.It prints in approximately 7 hours on my P1P using a 0.12mm layer height (recommended)
This model works really well with multicolour PLA silk filaments.
Included are .3mf and .stl files.
The model prints as the body abdomen legs and head as one part with the wings printed separately. The whole model is printed on one plate and can be assembled in 1-2 min.
I have found on occasion that the neck ball joint can become a bit loose, if this is the case you can apply a little bit of varnish or tacky glue to the ball.

description_text:
Detailed 3D model of a Butterfly Digestive System. This anatomically accurate model showcases the internal organs responsible for digestion in a butterfly (order Lepidoptera). Key components such as the proboscis (used for sucking nectar), esophagus, crop (for storage), midgut (where digestion and absorption occur), hindgut (for water absorption and waste elimination), and anus are clearly depicted. The model might also include associated structures like salivary glands. The design emphasizes the adaptations of the butterfly's digestive system to its liquid diet. This 3D model is ideal for educational purposes in biology, entomology, zoology, and comparative anatomy. It can be used in scientific visualizations, educational apps, and research projects focusing on insect anatomy and physiology. The model is provided in multiple formats: FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of 3D software and platforms.

description_text:
Robotic Anti-Rodent Spider is a print in place, no supports articulated model featuring mid and lower leg latching hinge joints, ball hinge hip joints and latching upper pedipalps hinge joints. The model will freely stand on its legs without collapsing. Also a static .stl version is included.
Included are .stl and .3mf of articulated model and a scalable static .stl version
The idea of the model is of a robotic spider similar to the size of a large real spider which could possibly be programmed for rodent control.
I would recommend using PLA+ as it will be a bit more reliable for the latching joints, however I have tested in regular PLA and it will work; make sure you use best printing practice, dry filament, check temperatures etc.
Gradient filaments look good with this model, as the material layers with the legs have a much higher material volume than the upper body; this results in a faster colour transition across the legs than across the body and abdomen.

Maidenhair Ginkgo Biloba Tree 01
Ginkgo biloba, commonly known as ginkgo or gingko also known as the maidenhair tree, is a species of gymnosperm tree native to East Asia. It is the last living species in the order Ginkgoales, which first appeared over 290 million years ago. Fossils very similar to the living species, belonging to the genus Ginkgo, extend back to the Middle Jurassic epoch approximately 170 million years ago. The tree has an angular crown and long, somewhat erratic branches, and is usually deep-rooted and resistant to wind and snow damage. Young trees are often tall and slender, and sparsely branched; the crown becomes broader as the tree ages. A combination of resistance to disease, insect-resistant wood, and the ability to form aerial roots and sprouts makes ginkgos durable, with some specimens claimed to be more than 2,500 years old.

description_text:
This model is a 1:1 scale, print in place, no supports, articulated representation of Meganeura which was a giant flying insect closely related to dragonflies, it lived 300 million years ago. Meganeura was the largest insect know to have existed with some the biggest examples having a wing span of up to 65 cm; however this model is of a slightly smaller example with the wing span of only 48 cm (this is because of print bed size limitations). 
The Model is printed on 2 plates:
Plate one with the print in place, no supports, articulated body which can be printed in multi colour or single colour (.3mf files provided for both). The multi colour (3 material) print takes approximately 24 hours and a single colour approximately 7 hours. (I used PLA in my example prints)
Second plate for the wings which have been included in two separate styles: a open wing cell version for single colour printing and a closed cell version for printing in multi colour with transparent membrane against solid colour veins. (I used transparent PETG and Black PETG in my example prints, I would also recommend a smooth surface print plate for best results) multi colour takes approximately 7 hours and single colour approximately 8 hours (the multi colour is quicker as the single colour version has more layers of the intricate vein patterns on the wings which are more time consuming than the solid layers of the transparent membrane in the colour profile)
After Printing the model can be easily and quickly assembled into a free standing model by flexing the latching leg joints and abdomen articulations and by popping the wings into their sockets. Please see included build video.
The model can then be displayed as a free standing model in multiple poses or perhaps suspended from the ceiling as if it were flying. 
Included are single colour and multi colour .3mf files as well as .stl's for all parts.
A bit about Meganeura:
Meganeura evolved during the late Carboniferous period until its extinction in the Permian period about three hundred million years ago. It dominated the earth for millions of years before the dinosaurs came on the scene. Like modern carnivorous insects, it lived near freshwater and thrived in humid wetlands. The insect existed in a time when marine life flourished, and so it was found near the edge of bodies of water, such as streams and ponds in the massive equatorial warm forests that covered the center of France.
Meganeura was an obligate carnivore with highly evolved bulging eyes, sharp chewing mouthparts, and a diverse diet. The large eyes allowed the massive insect to search for prey. Also, given its enormous size, it could pick from a wide variety of insects and eat small amphibians and other vertebrates. At the time, amphibians, like frogs and toads, were still getting used to a more terrestrial lifestyle. This would have made it easy for the Meganeura to catch and prey on them.
Like present-day dragonflies, Meganeua probably loitered around the edges of streams, ponds, and other water bodies where prey was abundant. Meganeura existed long before birds and bats came on the scene. This means it was the most prominent aerial predator at the time. 
Enjoy.

description_text:
Maidenhair Ginkgo Biloba Tree 09
Ginkgo biloba, commonly known as ginkgo or gingko also known as the maidenhair tree, is a species of gymnosperm tree native to East Asia. It is the last living species in the order Ginkgoales, which first appeared over 290 million years ago. Fossils very similar to the living species, belonging to the genus Ginkgo, extend back to the Middle Jurassic epoch approximately 170 million years ago. The tree was cultivated early in human history, remains commonly planted, and is widely regarded as a living fossil.G. biloba is a long-lived, disease-resistant, dioecious tree with unique fan-shaped leaves, capable of clonal reproduction, and known for its striking yellow autumn foliage and resilience in disturbed environments. It was known historically as “silver fruit” or “white fruit” in Chinese and called “ginkgo” due to a centuries-old transcription error. It is closely related to cycads and characterized by unique seeds that resemble apricots but are not true fruits.G. biloba in Tournai, BelgiumGinkgos are large trees, normally reaching a height of 20–35 m (66–115 ft),[8] with some specimens in China being over 50 m (165 ft). The tree has an angular crown and long, somewhat erratic branches, and is usually deep-rooted and resistant to wind and snow damage. Young trees are often tall and slender, and sparsely branched; the crown becomes broader as the tree ages. A combination of resistance to disease, insect-resistant wood, and the ability to form aerial roots and sprouts makes ginkgos durable, with some specimens claimed to be more than 2,500 years old.

description_text:
Dragonfly for Painting is a print in place, no supports design collection which will allow downloader to print dragonfly models of different sizes to be painted with creator's original and creative designs.Possibly use an educational art project, for decorating plant pots, windows etc.The design is related to another one of my models: Meganeura Dragonfly
Included are .STL, .3MF and .STEP format files for all parts in 3 configuration choices:

  - Full size articulating model with latching knee joints. (approx 8 hours print time @ 0.16mm layer height). This model is not scalable.

  - Small size articulating model (113 x 125 mm print footprint) version, the knees, hips and body segments are still articulated, but the legs do not latch into position; it will stand on its own, however the joints may need to be glued for stability. (2 hours print time @ 0.08mm layer height). This model is scalable.

  - A static/fixed pose model where the body is a single object with the wings printing separately. This model is scalable.

I used 0.16mm layer height for the full size print, and 0.8mm layer height for smaller size print. For the wings I used 0.2mm layer height in both cases.

description_text:
The Clockwork Beetle Scout is a highly-engineered mechanical miniature figurine designed for collectors, 3D-printing enthusiasts, tabletop gamers, and steampunk lovers. Built with micro-gear aesthetics, articulated limb segments, and a fully mechanical exoskeleton style, this model delivers exceptional visual complexity while remaining fully printable on both FDM and Resin machines.
Its design blends vintage clockwork engineering with biomechanical insect anatomy, making it an ideal showpiece for mechanical toy lovers, diorama creators, custom table-set builders, and hobby painters. The model features enhanced detailing around the thorax, hinge-joint legs, optical lens eyes, and layered armor plates — ensuring crisp details when printed in high-resolution resin and strong structure when printed in FDM.
Perfect for display, mechanical toy collections, gift items, resin showcases, steampunk builds, and creative engineering projects.
3D printing settingsFDM Print Settings
Layer Height: 0.12–0.20 mm
Infill: 15–25%
Walls: 2–3
Top Layers: 4–5
Supports: Required under legs and abdomen
Filament: PLA / PLA+ recommended
Print Speed: 40–55 mm/s
Bed Temp: 60°C
Nozzle Temp: 200–210°C
Best Orientation: Belly down at slight tilt
Resin Print Settings

Supports: Medium density, medium contact
Resin Type: Standard / ABS-like resin
Exposure Time: 2.2–2.8 sec (depends on printer)
Lift Speed: Slow for leg preservation

It can also be used in scenarios such as children's space decoration and as a character prototype for animated short films.Design ElementsHead: Retains the typical facial outline of a squirrel, with round ears, cute blushes, and is paired with a hooded design, adding a sense of childlikeness and fashion.Clothing: Dressed in a simple hooded coat, with rich details such as zippers and pockets. description_text:
Here is an old skull. Discovered without the bottom jaw but luckily most of the teeth are still present. Years of weather has rounded most of the corners but somehow remains pretty well preserved.
Fourteen bones form the facial skeleton. There is the mandible (jaw bone) the vomer (gives shape to your nose) and then a series of paired bones (as in there is a left and a right): the nasals, maxillae, lacrimals, zygomatics, palatines, and the inferior nasal conchae. The face is also formed by the nasal cartilages (a group of connective tissue structures that give shape to the framework of your nose) and by the teeth (the upper arch of teeth are attached to the maxillae and the lower arch of teeth are attached to the mandible).The ethmoid bone, located at the roof of the nose and between the eyes, has tiny foramina. Nerve cells in the nose detect odors, carry those signals through the foramina in the ethmoid, and to the olfactory bulbs. From there, the signals move along the olfactory tracts to the brain. The palatine bones help give shape to the back of the roof of the mouth, the floor of the nasal cavity, and the floor of the orbits.

description_text:
Antlers 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 7428 vertices, 7424 quad faces (14848 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text: Elephants are the largest existing land animals. Three living species are currently recognised: the African bush elephant, the African forest elephant, and the Asian elephant. They are an informal grouping within the family Elephantidae of the order Proboscidea. Elephantidae is the only surviving family of proboscideans; extinct members include the mastodons. Elephantidae also contains several extinct groups, including the mammoths and straight-tusked elephants. African elephants have larger ears and concave backs, whereas Asian elephants have smaller ears, and convex or level backs. Distinctive features of all elephants include a long proboscis called a trunk, tusks, large ear flaps, massive legs, and tough but sensitive skin. The trunk is used for breathing, bringing food and water to the mouth, and grasping objects. Tusks, which are derived from the incisor teeth, serve both as weapons and as tools for moving objects and digging. The large ear flaps assist in maintaining a constant body temperature as well as in communication. The pillar-like legs carry their great weight.

A ring is a round band, usually of metal, worn as ornamental jewellery. The term ring by itself always denotes jewellery worn on the finger; when worn as an ornament elsewhere, the body part is specified within the term, e.g., earrings, neck rings, arm rings, and toe rings. Rings always fit snugly around or in the part of the body they ornament, so bands worn loosely, like a bracelet, are not rings. Rings may be made of almost any hard material: wood, bone, stone, metal, glass, gemstone or plastic. They may be set with gemstones (diamond, ruby, sapphire or emerald) or with other types of stone or glass.Although some wear rings as mere ornaments or as conspicuous displays of wealth, rings have symbolic functions concerning marriage, exceptional achievement, high status or authority, membership in an organization, and the like. Rings can be made to sport insignia which may be impressed on a wax seal or outfitted with a small compartment in which to conceal things. In myth, fable, and fiction, rings are often endowed with spiritual or supernatural significance.

description_text:
This is a alligator skull model. It is or may not bef entirly accurate to a real alligator skull but is very high in detail. This model is to scale and ready to be 3D printed. On the inside of the skull you can also see the teeth which can be seen and felt on a 3D print. All of the details come out very fine.

  - I reccomend setting the alligator verticle when 3d printing (nose pointing up) this will capture the most detail possible while also using a bit less filliment. 

  - Can be printed with normal or tree supports, tree supports are easier to remove.

  - WARNING READ; when printing the aligator vertical as recommended, make sure to add extra supports along the jaw bones, In my experiance the jaw bones wiggle too much when printing causing them to have terrible detail and weakened sturctures or break entirly, the rest of the skull will print fine however. To ensure the jaw prints seemlessly with the skull, get the cura add support add-on, this will let you click on the model and add supports where needed, you will just need to add supports enough to prevent the jaw from wiggiling until it is able to connect with the rest of the model while printing.(Another way to explain this; when the printer is putting a layer down on the jaws, it also drags on it a bit making it come loose and potentially turn into spegettii. such as printing a tall very thin tower)

I did use blender and cura to get my final print result, as such I exported my project from blender in meters, in cura it is conveted into millimeters. If importing the model into another software or into blender, it may be significanly larger than expected. as such it can just be rescaled.
around;

  - 774,458 vertices

  - 774,494 faces

  - 1,548,990 Triangles

Destoroyah (デストロイア Desutoroia) is a crustacean kaiju who first appeared in the 1995 Toho Godzilla film Godzilla vs. Destoroyah.
Godzilla's final opponent in the Heisei series, Destoroyah is the incarnation of the Oxygen Destroyer, the chemical weapon used to kill the original Godzilla in 1954. When the weapon was detonated at the bottom of Tokyo Bay, it revived a colony of Precambrian crustaceans trapped in the strata, and the resulting anaerobic conditions caused the creatures to undergo an abnormal path of mutation and evolution until they finally came to the surface in 1996. Able to grow and evolve by combining with each other, the creatures took on numerous different forms before finally converging into a single gigantic demonic monster. Destoroyah fought Godzilla at the peak of his power and nearly defeated him, but was finally destroyed by a combination of the JSDF's ULT cryolasers and the extreme heat given off by the near-meltdown Godzilla.

description_text:
This piece is representative of the original Mortal Kombat 4 Arcade Cabinet.
Mortal Kombat 4 is the fourth main installment in the Mortal Kombat series of fighting games developed by Midway Games. Released to arcades in 1997, Mortal Kombat 4 is the first title from the series, and one of the first made by Midway overall, to use 3D computer graphics. It is also the last game of the series to have an arcade release.
The idea behind this project was to recreate this arcade cabinet by using lithophanes to act as the original vinyl panels.
This is a 2 piece set, composed of the arcade cabinet itself and it's base. I've shown an example in the pictures how we can light up this piece, but take into consideration that we can use the light according to your own creativity (different colors, intensity, position, etc.).
Behind the piece you will find a small hole just in case you want to use a light source with a cord (e.g. LED strip).
The arcade cabinet dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 211
Width- 93
Depth- 121
The base of the arcade cabinet dimensions are the following (mm): 
Height- 9
Width- 93
Depth- 112
Sculpting software used: Blender
Render method used for the previews: Cycles
Filament: PLA
Slicer used to 3D print: Ultimaker Cura
Settings I've used to 3D print:
Standard quality - 0.2mm
Infill - 99%
Supports - I've used regular supports for the control panel (joystick with buttons) and for the top of the arcade (inner supports).
Speed - 50% first 20 layers and 100% for the rest
Plate Adhesion - Skirt
Cooling - Enabled
Travel - Retraction Enabled

description_text: The design is of an alien bust with gray characteristics, the design was inspired by a human being with certain characteristics such as the mouth and nose.The skin was designed combining those of a reptile since they usually always appear with elephant skin, on the face it also has a lot of detail in the skin, with wrinkles in case you want to print it in resin.It can be printed in PLA or resin, the size is adjusted according to your needs.I left the size at 10 cm high with everything and the base, but remember that you can change the size, in case you want it smaller or larger.PARAMETERSThe parameters are left for your considerationquality: if it is in PLA 0.1 for the details in the skinFilling: yes, I recommend 15 to 20% from experience, since we do not want to waste material but it can break in a fall, the filling is important.Walls: 5 better to secure in case it fallsspeed 40 and 35 because of the details that the figure has

Concise 3D model of an Eastern Newt crawling. Depicts an Eastern Newt (Notophthalmus viridescens) in a crawling pose. This small salamander is known for its distinct life stages, including an aquatic larva, a terrestrial juvenile red eft, and an aquatic adult. The model showcases the newt moving forward on its short legs, with its slender body close to the ground and its tail trailing. Key features include its characteristic coloration (which varies by life stage) and small size. Suitable for educational materials about amphibians, wildlife visualizations, biological studies, and virtual environment creation. Available in FBX, OBJ, STL, GLB, USDZ, and BLEND formats.

description_text:
Command attention with this formidable High-Poly Crocodile/Alligator Sculpture 3D Model. This realistic statue captures the raw power of a primal predator, posed dynamically with its mouth wide open, teeth bared, ready to strike. The model boasts exceptional surface detail, including intense scale texture across the body, claws, and tail, and rests on an elegant, sculpted classical pedestal.
Originality and Essential Qualities: The model's originality lies in the dramatic, dynamic pose and the hyper-realistic sculpting of the reptilian skin. It is an essential purchase for serious collectors because it is a high-polygon, watertight mesh engineered to deliver museum-quality realism when printed, making it an imposing and striking display piece.
Use:
Primary Use: 3D Printing as a grand collectible trophy, a unique desk sculpture, or an impressive piece of wildlife art for display.
Art & Decor: Perfect for a study, library, or games room, symbolizing primal strength and danger.
Casting & Finishing: An ideal source model for cold casting or achieving a realistic weathered bronze or painted finish.
Context of Use and Technical SpecificationsInspiration: Inspired by tropical wildlife and classical animalier bronze sculptures, emphasizing the creature's aggressive stance and rough hide.
Context of Use: Intended for experienced 3D printing enthusiasts with high-resolution machines (Resin) who demand fine surface detail in their collectibles.
Unrivaled File Format Compatibility: The model is delivered in an extensive list of formats, suitable for both high-resolution printing and digital rendering, including: STL, OBJ, FBX, GLB, 3DS, DAE, WRL, USDZ, and many more.
Limitations: The open jaws, thin teeth, and the aggressive stance create numerous challenging overhangs that require maximum support. It is strictly a static sculpture.Manufacturing and Technical DetailsThis complex model requires advanced setup and maximum support.
Machine Type: Resin (SLA/DLP) is mandatory to capture the intricate scale texture, sharp teeth, and detailed pedestal geometry.
Materials:
Resin: High-resolution UV-curing Resin.
Resolution (Layer Height):
Resin: 0.03mm - 0.05mm is critical for maximizing scale and texture detail.
Infill: Hollowing is strongly recommended for Resin to save material and weight, while preserving structural integrity.
Supports: EXTREMELY HEAVY SUPPORTS ARE REQUIRED. Supports must be densely placed under the open upper jaw, the belly, and the tail overhangs.
Estimated Size: Print at least 100mm - 150mm in length for the full textural detail to be apparent.
Safety and ComplianceIntended Use: Decorative use only (Art Sculpture/Statue).
Child Hazard: The sharp teeth and thin extremities are fragile and may create sharp fragments; keep away from small children.
Food Contact: Not safe for food contact.

The model features a massive muscular reptilian fighter with thick scaled skin, a powerful torso, clawed feet, and a row of dramatic dorsal spikes running down the back, creating an imposing silhouette from every angle.
The character stands in a strong, confident pose that emphasizes its heavy musculature and reptilian anatomy. From the broad chest and sculpted abdominal muscles to the detailed arms and legs, every surface of the model has been carefully crafted to showcase texture and form. The creature's head features a strong reptilian structure with layered scales, while the back spikes and tail add visual balance and an aggressive fantasy presence.
The character wears simple fighter shorts that contrast with the creature’s organic textures, giving the design a modern creature-warrior look suitable for fantasy, creature collections, or display statues. The skin texture includes scale patterns and subtle wrinkles that print beautifully and respond well to painting and weathering techniques.
At 290mm tall, this statue becomes a strong display centerpiece suitable for collectors, creature designers, and 3D printing enthusiasts. The large scale allows the details of the scales, muscles, and spikes to print clearly on both resin and FDM printers.
The model prints as a single piece and can be hand painted after printing to achieve realistic reptile tones, fantasy monster colors, or stylized creature finishes. Once finished, it becomes a dramatic creature statue ideal for shelves, desks, or display cabinets.Painting and Finishing GuideThis model is designed to be hand painted after printing. Begin with a grey or black primer to establish a strong base for paint layers. Apply base reptile tones such as green, olive, tan, or grey to the skin areas.
Use washes to deepen the scale details and muscle separation. Dry brushing lighter tones over raised scales will highlight the texture and bring the sculpt to life. The spikes and claws can be painted with bone or ivory tones, while the shorts can be colored in darker neutral tones for contrast.
Finish with a matte varnish to protect the paint and enhance the natural reptile look.

Eocarcharia  is an extinct genus of theropod dinosaurs found in what is now the western Ténéré Desert of Niger. It is known from several skull bones collected in 2000 by an expedition to the Early Cretaceous (Aptian–Albian ages) Elrhaz Formation (Gadoufaoua locality) led by American paleontologist Paul Sereno.

  - consists of several objects: body, eyes, claws, and teeth.

The model's original software is Blender.The ZIP file contains:

  - 3 folders for each skin;

  - In each folder: a Blender file, an FBX file, an unwrapped mesh, a normal map, and a preview.

description_text:
This is a realistic 3D model of a fridge magnet souvenir. It is meant for either rendering or 3d printing.

  - Model is scaled to real world scale in metric units, and is placed very near / above the ground.

  - Mesh is unique (only one object), 100% quads and completely watertight.

  - STL file has 6 level iteration subdivision and displacement already applied, so the polygon and vertices number is completely different. It is ready for 3d print.

  - Two OBJ Files with different subdivision levels: one with no subdivisions or displacement applied, the other with 6 iterations and displacement applied.

  - The model has diffuse, normal, specular and displacement maps. All 4096x4096 in resolution. When rendering, the normal map should only be used if the displacement map is not used. Otherwise, the results might not be as good.

  - All textures are in PNG format.

  - Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Arnold and Default materials included for 3ds Max. V-Ray materials for Cinema4D. Default standard materials for Blender, OBJ and FBX version.

  - No isolated vertices, no overlapping vertices or faces, no missing textures.

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.
