Quick Allosaurus Facts

  - This dinosaur weighed about half as much as an African Elephant 

  - It stood 16 feet tall; 3 feet taller than the average elephant 

  - It was 40 feet or longer; this made it as long as 3 Hippos 

  - Allosaurus means “different lizard” 

  - It could move at about 20 MPH—the speed of a charging giraffe.

About Allosaurus
Allosaurus is a type of dinosaur called a therapod. This dinosaur lived about 155 million years ago—during the Jurassic Period—and probably lived in parts of the Western United States. It was first discovered in 1869 by Ferdinand Hayden and was later named in 1877 by Othniel Charles Marsh. It was named using the Greek words “allos”, which meant different, and “saurus” which meant lizard. Therefore, it’s name literally means “different lizard”. It was given this name because its skeleton was quite different than any other dinosaur found up until the time of its discovery.
Although most of the specimens of this dinosaur have been found in Colorado and Montana, there have been an increasing number of specimens found elsewhere. These include specimens found in New Mexico, Africa, Australia. Tanzania and parts of Europe.
This dinosaur was a large carnivorous bipedal predator that scientists believe preyed on the many herbivores of the time. This conclusion has been reached in part by the number of razor sharp teeth that can be found in this predator’s mouth. It had rows of razor sharp teeth that had saw-like formations on its edges. It is believed that the Allosaurus was able to attack larger predators with these teeth by using its upper jaw like a hatchet and attacking using the element of surprise.
One interesting fact to note is that the largest Allosaurus specimens may have rivaled the T- Rex in size. The size of the largest Allosaurus is approximately 16 feet tall, 43 feet long and weighed more up to 5 tons. This contrasts pretty well with the T- Rex who was approximately 13-16 feet tall, 42 feet long and weighed approximately 7 tons.
Quick Deinocheirus Facts

  - May have climbed trees like modern sloths 

  - Deinocheirus is the largest bird mimic of all time 

  - Weighs as much as an African Elephant 

  - Was 3 car lengths long 

  - Was as large as a Tyrannosaurus Rex 

  - Had 10 inch claws and 8 foot long arms

About Deinocheirus
Deinocheirus was one of the most mysterious dinosaurs to have ever been found by paleontologists. It was originally found in 1965 in Southern Mongolia—actually, not the whole dinosaur was found but only its gigantic hands. And for the next 50 years, that is all that scientists would have of this elusive dinosaur. That is probably why its name means “terrible hand”.
That changed in 2012, when 3 paleontologists—Phil Bell, Yuong- Nam Lee and Philip J. Currie—discovered 2 new specimens that would reveal all of the secrets that this dinosaur once held. Secrets of its size and what it is believed to have eaten. Up until that point, the only thing that was really known about this dinosaur was that it had massive hands and lived about 70 million years ago during the late Cretaceous Period.
Deinocheirus was around 30 feet long, almost 15 feet high and weighed about 6 tons. It was a bipedal dinosaur—from a species called Ornithomimids, which are sometimes called ‘ostrich dinosaurs’ and was the biggest of these dinosaurs. However, it probably didn’t move like an ostrich. Due to its large size and weight, it more than likely lumbered along and didn’t run very quickly. I
It is believed that this dinosaur was a scavenger of sorts. It is believed to have eaten a variety of different things such as fish, invertebrates, plants and maybe even insects. It probably didn’t hunt prey like a predator. However, an interesting fact about this dinosaur is that it was probably frequently hunted by tyrannosaurus dinosaurs, as bite marks on its skeleton would suggest.
About Anchisaurus
Anchisaurus was originally named Megadactylus polyzelus by Edward Hitchcock‭; ‬however after his death it was realised that that Megadactylus had already been used to name another creature,‭ ‬and so it could not be used.‭ ‬Later in‭ ‬1885,‭ ‬the famous American palaeontologists Othniel Charles Marsh renamed the fossils Anchisaurus,‭ ‬as well as identifying the remains as being those of a dinosaur.‭ The exact classification of Anchisaurus has long been a subject of debate,‭ ‬with some sources labelling it as a prosauropod,‭ ‬while later thinking places it as a sauropodomorph.‭ ‬Additionally another genus called Ammosaurus has been regularly speculated to be the same dinosaur as Anchisaurus even though there are some differences in the pelvis and hind feet between these two genera.‭ ‬Regardless of its exact placement,‭ ‬Anchisaurus is a representative of the kinds of dinosaurs that would steadily grow bigger and become the quadrupedal sauropods of the later Jurassic. The blunt teeth and jaw construction of Anchisaurus have been interpreted as clear signs that Anchisaurus was a plant eating dinosaur.‭ ‬Additionally the body is shaped to allow for an increased gut area for the digestion of plant matter.‭ ‬Some palaeontologists have speculated however that Anchisaurus may have eaten meat since the eyes still face partially forward rather than to the sides like most plant eating animals that are usually prey for meat eaters.‭ ‬Additionally the‭ ‘‬thumb‭’ ‬digit‭ (‬actually a reversible first digit‭) ‬had a claw sharpened beyond that necessary for a herbivore.‭ ‬However what is certain is that dinosaurs like Anchisaurus were descended from meat eating ancestors,‭ ‬and with this in mind it is reasonable to speculate that the partially carnivorous/predatory features present in Anchisaurus may just be relict features that were yet to evolve out.

description_text:
Supported versions now available!
Hands are usually a tough thing to find in mechs and knights.  You want to make a custom figure, or include a special bit in a diorama, and you're limited to fixed fists or other generic configurations.
In my case, as a Knight player, I was tired of being limited by the factory kit, plus the fact that it had only three fingers bothered me.
So, I designed my own.
NOTE: Don't buy this file if you already bought or plan to buy the Project IronHorse files.  These are included in that bulk package.<<<
Here's four fingers, one thumb, and 16+ different poses (one of which is unfused, so you can customize in Meshmixer, 3D Builder, or the CAD program of your choice).
Pointing, grabbing, punching, grasping, or flipping the bird.  There are files for most everything!
You'll notice that the hands are all right.  If you want a left hand, it's easily reversed in your slicer program or 3D builder.  If there are any special requests, reach out via site message.
Included in this file are the numerous hand poses, the main weapon body which forms the elbow, and five upper arms in various lengths and styles.  These are set up for magnetization, and can click up to your own 12mm x 2mm magnets.
There are also five upper arms that are compatible with factory kits, and can be magnetized on their own.  Make sure your poles match before gluing.
Best,JBR
Print SettingsSupported and Clean versions are now included in the zipped folders.  Woot!

description_text:
This is the low-poly version of my _Suchomimus _which I am making for my series of short films, Mesosoica. _Suchomimus _was a large spinosaurid that lived in central Africa during the middle cretaceous period. It would have hunted fish in a similar way to a heron, waiting by the side of a river or lake and snatching up fish as they swim past. It had a little crest on its head which it probably used to recognize each other and maybe to impress a potential mate. 
As I progress making the models for the show I will upload all of the steps. You are free to use the assets as you wish, just please credit in the description or caption of your creation. Also tag me (@ashermolony) or let me know what you've made, I'd love to see all of the cool things you can make with it.

description_text:
Hook made in Catia V5 and rendered in Keyshot Pro 10.
A hook is a tool consisting of a length of material, typically metal, that contains a portion that is curved or indented, such that it can be used to grab onto, connect, or otherwise attach itself onto another object. In a number of uses, one end of the hook is pointed, so that this end can pierce another material, which is then held by the curved or indented portion. Some kinds of hooks, particularly fish hooks, also have a barb, a backwards-pointed projection near the pointed end of the hook to ensure that once the hook is embedded in its target, it can not easily be removed.

description_text:
Destoroyah grows quickly and adopts several appearances throughout the film, including his microscopic form, 3-mm form, insect-sized form, 2-meter form, 18-meter crab-like forms, a larger aggregate crab-like form, a bat-like flying form, and a bipedal 120-meter, demonic final form. In all his forms, Destoroyah's exoskeleton ranges from bright red to a wine red/maroon tone, and in his later forms, his belly is bright red.
In their pre-mutated form, the microorganisms that would become Destoroyah resemble trilobites of the order Harpetida.
In his first form, Destoroyah resembles a tiny trilobite, with a flattened shell and multiple spiked protrusions emerging from its shell which vaguely resembles its later forms' head crests. This form is about a centimeter long, and was first observed consuming fish in an aquarium.
Its next form is approximately human-sized, and moves upon six crustacean-like legs. This form already sports a horned, crested head similar to that of the final form, but its mouth is insect-like with multiple sets of mandibles.
When attacked, the numerous individual juvenile forms merge together into the aggregate form, which is nearly identical to the juvenile form except much bigger. It now has a pair of spike-pointed arms emerging from its back, as well with two smaller carb like claws on both sides of the chest. An extra protruding jaw that can inject micro-oxygen.

description_text:
The Defiler is a Zerg Hive tech unit. It is one of the Zerg's most powerful spell casters. A support unit, it is most well known for its Dark Swarm and Plague abilities.
The Defiler is late game unit requiring the Hive and Defiler Mound, at which time it can be morphed at any of the Zerg player's Hatcheries, Lair, or Hive. It does not deal any damage directly, thus is easily susceptible to opponent attack. As such, Defilers usually travel along with Zerg armies as a support unit rather than traveling individually. Despite this, Defilers are relatively slow and move in an inelegant slither, and thus easily fall to the rear of the Zerg forces. To mitigate this, it is common for the Zerg to transport Defilers in Overlords and as part of a drop attack. Defilers are most commonly used against Terran and Protoss, against whom their spells are most effective.

description_text:
The Devourer is a rarely-seen Hive-tech air-to-air unit that requires a Greater Spire to morph from a Mutalisk. As an expensive, powerful anti-air support unit, it rarely fits the meta; Zerg rarely tech up and pursue air superiority. It deals slow single-target damage, but its attack splashes and applies a debuff called Acid Spores. They pair well with Mutalisks, whose attack bounces three times. Air units tend to cluster, making Devourers powerful in large-scale air battles, particularly against capital ships, whose heavy armor suffers from the Acid Spores.
Though faster than Guardians, they still move slowly; faster units outmaneuver them. They find most use defensively and in final battles. Their high health and armor discourage focus from enemies, and their range exceeds that of most air-to-air attacks. Their cost leans toward minerals; a breath of fresh air for a gas-starved late-game Mutalisk army.

description_text: The Lurker is a Zerg unit that may attack only when burrowed and is also able to burrow without the mutation being evolved. A Hydralisk can be morphed to a Lurker when a Lurker Den has been constructed. The Lurker deals damage to all enemy ground units and buildings in a linear attack, similar to a Hellion. Each spine that spikes out of the ground has an individual splash zone with a radius of 0.5. There are 10 spines in the attack that are each offset about 1 full cell from each other from the Lurker to the target unit. There is a 0.125 second delay between each protruding spine, resulting in a full 1.25 seconds to fire an entire line of spines. This makes it possible to dodge the outer spines with reactive micro.

description_text:
The Colossus (plural -lossi, -lossuses) is a massive Protoss battle strider that towers over all other ground units on the battlefield. It is built at the Robotics Facility, but requires the presence of a Robotics Bay to be unlocked. Its long-range dual Thermal Lances target units in a wide linear area of effect, perpendicular to the Colossus's direction of fire. This makes the Colossus a powerful siege unit that can quickly destroy an enemy's ground forces.
Colossi have massive legs and enormous height, which can both be an advantage and disadvantage. Firstly, the height allows anti-air attacks to hit it; care must be taken with Colossi to make sure units like Vikings or Corruptors do not pick them off in battle as they are relatively fragile units for their cost. Secondly, its weapon comes with a base range of 7, and the Extended Thermal Lance upgrade extends it to an impressive attack range of 9, which allows it to attack from behind the main Protoss army. Thirdly, the legs grant them the ability to traverse cliffs and provide vision of high ground areas, as well as stacking over other units in the player's army. However unlike smaller ranged units, if a Colossus is on the high ground and attacks enemy units on the low ground, the enemy gains temporary vision of the Colossus and can return fire. This revealing mechanic does put a limit their ability to exploit high ground, but can still be useful for engaging short ranged units. Overall, care must be taken to account for these unique characteristics, but these also help make the colossus a powerful unit.

  - The Overall ConceptThis asset is a masterpiece of industrial logistics. It is a long, segmented mechanical centipede vehicle, perfect for serving as an automated ore transport, a high-capacity supply train, or a unique multi-part boss in steampunk and factory-themed game worlds.

  - Modular Segmented BodyThe vehicle is composed of seven identical, box-like metal segments. Each segment features a deep, open-top cargo bay, suggesting it can carry massive amounts of materials or even be used as a moving platform for player characters.

  - Articulated Leg SystemThe centipede walks on dozens of small, spindly mechanical legs. Each segment is equipped with multiple pairs of these articulated limbs, giving the machine a creepy, insect-like movement that is sure to stand out in any environment.

  - Exposed Clockwork GearsThe sides and rear of the vehicle are detailed with large brass gears, cogs, and intricate wiring. These mechanical details highlight the primitive but complex technology powering the crawler's long-distance transport capabilities.

  - Weathered Industrial FinishThe body is constructed from heavily riveted steel plates with a realistic brushed metal texture. Subtle rust patches and grime along the seams give the vehicle a rugged, industrial look that fits perfectly into a working-class steampunk aesthetic.

You can easily add or remove segments to change the vehicle's length, or apply a Follow Path script with a slight delay for each segment to create a realistic, undulating crawling motion.

Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall ConceptThis asset is a agile marvel of steampunk engineering. It is a small, mechanical vehicle designed to look like a grasshopper, perfect for high-speed jumping, scouting, or serving as a unique player mount in alternate-history or fantasy game worlds.

  - High-Tension Suspension SpringsThe vehicle's most impressive feature is its pair of large, vertical chrome coil springs.   - Large Cog-Wheel DriveThe grasshopper moves on two oversized, gear-toothed wheels. These industrial metal cogs feature deep ridges for gripping rough terrain and are connected to the central engine by smaller interlocking brass gears, emphasizing its clockwork heart.

  - Polished Steel Insect HeadThe front of the vehicle is designed with a sleek, rounded silver head featuring large, hemispherical eyes. Two long, thin wire antennae extend from the top, giving the vehicle a recognizable and friendly biological personality despite its metallic construction.

  - Single-Rider Leather SaddleThe cockpit is a simple, high-backed bucket seat upholstered in pristine white leather. Positioned directly behind the silver handlebars, this open-air seating arrangement allows for a wide range of player-character animations and easy customization.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures).Quick Tip: The Main Springs and Cog-Wheels are separate mesh groups. You can easily link a Bounce animation to the springs that triggers upon landing, making the vehicle feel responsive and alive during platforming gameplay.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall ConceptThis asset is a towering achievement in clockwork robotics. It is a tall, slender mechanical mantis walker, perfect for serving as an elegant royal transport, a terrifying high-speed enemy, or a specialized harvesting unit in steampunk and dark fantasy game worlds.

  - Serrated Saw-Blade ScythesThe walker’s front limbs are two massive, heavy-duty metal scythes with serrated saw-teeth. These intimidating blades are connected by industrial chains, suggesting they can be used for both clearing dense vegetation and lethal combat.

  - Elegant Filigree CanopyThe driver’s area is protected by a beautiful, arched metal canopy featuring intricate floral filigree patterns. This decorative touch, combined with the high-backed black leather seat, gives the vehicle a refined, high-society steampunk aesthetic.

  - External Drive-Train GearsThe core of the machine is a complex network of exposed brass gears and cogs of various sizes. These interlocking parts are visible along the spine and hip joints, emphasizing the realistic mechanical engineering behind its movement.

  - Tripod Stilt-Leg ChassisThe mantis stands on three long, spindly stilt-legs that end in flat, stabilizing feet. This unique tripod design allows the walker to tower over other characters while maintaining a narrow footprint, perfect for navigating crowded industrial streets or forest paths.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures).Quick Tip: The Front Scythes and External Gears are separate mesh groups. You can easily apply a Reciprocating animation to the saws and a Rotation script to the gears to create a highly detailed and interactive idle state for the walker.

It utilizes brushed titanium-gold armor plating for the main structural components, deep matte black for the synthetic muscle fibers, and bright neon blue for the external coolant or neural cables. The structural layout from the forearm up to the shoulder coupling is designed to look anatomically and mechanically flawless.
Integrated Neural CablingAdding to its distinct silhouette are the external, flexible blue conduits wrapping around the upper bicep area. These cables provide a clear visual narrative of power transfer or neural linking, breaking up the hard metallic surfaces and offering a sense of dynamic functionality to the robotic limb.
Performance-Optimized Game GeometryEngineered with Game-Ready performance in mind, the Atlas-Prime Cybernetic Low-Poly 3D Model utilizes advanced baking to provide intricate geometric depth without the heavy polygon cost. All components are modeled as solid, opaque geometry, ensuring full compatibility with VR/AR applications and standard game engines while maintaining critical mechanical detail.

description_text:
Beautiful and good quality model. With care and dedication we cure and verify that our 3D models are in perfect shape so they can get printed with ease.
We took care in the curing of our models because we believe in high quality models and our products show it. Dedication and passion are our fuel and we love it.
This model is ment for mulpiple purposes and leave the door open to new ideas, in the mean time you can place it by the desk or shelf because it fits in many locations around the house, office,...
Set your house, office or any place that requires an exquisite touch a piece of love and dedication.
This model is cured meaning that all the errors in the mesh produced by the heavy modification along the creation procedure are solved. To ensure that there are no vertices's left not connected to the mesh several equations are passed through the rough mesh. After cleaning process a nice, beautiful and elegant model is whats left behind. It takes several iterations to achieve this stage so verifications alongside the process are a must. A good quality and nice looking 3D model is only the result of hard work. By ensuring this you will have a comfortable 3D print from our side, however you whant to do it is up to you.
Broad available formats for many different purposes:
-.stl   StereoLithoGraphy    -.ply   Standard Poligon File Format    -.obj   Alias Wavefont Object    -.dxf   AutoCAD DXF    -.dae   Collada    -.blend Blender    -.ms3d  Milkshape 3D    -.xyz   XYZ Point Cloud    -.json  JavaScript JSON
We are clear with our offerings, What You See Is What You Get.
Happy Printing ;)

description_text:
Non realistic horse high quality model. With just the right amount of polygons to make it look soft and 42K polygons, it also includes a version with around 2500 polygons only, and another version with 2 million polygons, made from solid parts so that it can be 3D printed. It will accept perfectly different types of materials, or changes in textures, color can be  adjusted by adjusting the hue value of the image as it is monochromatic (white, black and red in the original version).

  - Watertight parts.

  - Quads only.

  - Modeled to scale, if your software changes the size while importing, use 2 meteres or  cm or 6.56' on the tall side.

However the model was built to meet the requirements of the protocol. Notably correct topology, UV specifications, size, etc.

  - The model is originally made in Lightwave.

  - Includes different subdivision levels for each format.

  - Formats included: .lwo, .obj, .fbx, .stl, .lxo (.obj contains UV information and is an industry standard that most software can use)

Included are textures to make it game or real time engine ready.

  - Includes a .stl file for physical recreation, like 3d printing.

  - Includes a high subdivision version and different formats like .igs are available upon request.

description_text:
Meet the Articulated Print-in-Place Lizard – Includes 2 Head Options!
Bring this unique Articulated Print-in-Place Lizard to life with your 3D printer! Designed for smooth movement and reliable printing, the articulated body prints in one piece with no supports required. The head is printed separately, allowing you to choose between two different versions depending on your preferred finish.
** Features**

  - Print-in-place articulated body

  - Separate head for easy customization

  - Two head options included:
  - Head with printable eyes

  - Head with 8 mm glass eye sockets for a more realistic appearance

  - No supports required

  - Minimal assembly (simply attach the head)

  - Optimized for FDM 3D printing

  - Looks fantastic in both single-color and multi-color prints

  - Great as a desk toy, collectible, display piece, or gift

Size
At 100% scale, the articulated lizard body measures approximately:

  -  Length: 191 mm (7.52 in)

  -  Width: 75 mm (2.95 in)

  -  Height: 26 mm (1.02 in)

Dimensions refer to the articulated body only (head not included in the length).
Recommended Print Settings

  - Printer: FDM

  - Layer Height: 0.15 mm

  - Infill: 10–15%

  - Walls/Perimeters: 2

  - Supports: Not required

  - Brim: Optional (only if you experience adhesion issues)

  - Material: PLA recommended

  - Nozzle Temperature: 210–220°C

  - Bed Temperature: 55–60°C

All parts have been designed for support-free printing to make the printing process as easy and reliable as possible.
Download Includes

  - Pre-painted Bambu Studio (.3MF) project

  - Pre-painted PrusaSlicer (.3MF) project

  - Pre-painted ELEGOO Slicer (.3MF) project

  - STL files for the articulated lizard body

  - Head with printable eyes

  - Head with sockets for 8 mm glass eyes

  - The included 3MF projects come pre-painted and are ready for multi-color printing in their respective slicers.

Scaling Notice
This model has been carefully tuned for smooth articulation at its original size. Scaling the model up or down may alter the joint tolerances, causing the articulated sections to become either too tight or too loose.

description_text:
This ant farm is supposed to print in 3 printing-friendly parts:

  - The main body

  - The main cover

  - The tank lid

The body is made to fit a 95,15 mm inner diameter cylinder (preferably acrylic, as glass usually have tolerances up to 2mm) But I suggest to printing scaling it to your needs with your slicer. To do it, first select the main cover STL which would give you the exact diameter of the ant farm body, scale it to your requirements and use the same scaling on the other files.
Depending on the filament used, you may need to varnish the deposit and body interior in order to prevent leaks. I suggest to place a strap of PVA foam in the bypass between the both areas in order to let through the moisture and just keep the tank filled with water, preventing possible damages flooding the lowest chambers.
One of the lowest chambers is drilled with five 1mm holes in order to let moisture get into the farm. I highly recommend to place some stainless steel woven mesh on the inner wall of the body (easily done melting it CAREFULLY with a soldering iron). This is a MUST in case you plan on putting small species in there.Once all the inner needs are done, you just need to place the main cover and glue it to the main body (be extra careful lining up the access hole).

Caterpie is an insect Pokémon that resembles a green caterpillar with a yellow underside and teardrop-shaped tail. There are yellow ring-shaped markings down the sides of its segmented body, which resemble its eyes and are meant to scare off predators. Its most notable characteristic is the bright red antenna (osmeterium) on its head, which releases a stench to repel predators. Despite these features and its camouflage in green foliage, Caterpie is often preyed upon by Flying-type Pokémon. Its four tiny feet are tipped with suction cups, permitting this Pokémon to scale most surfaces with minimal effort.
Caterpie is easy to capture and grows quickly, making it ideal for new Trainers. As Caterpie grows and develops over time, it will shed its skin many times before finally cocooning itself in thick silk. It can also spit this silk in order to entangle foes as seen in the anime. It has a voracious appetite, which drives it to eat a hundred leaves a day. It will even eat leaves bigger than itself. According to Pokémon Adventures, its favorite food is the Vermilion flower. Caterpie lives in temperate forests and jungles.

Chōmei and the tailed beasts first came into being in the waning days of Hagoromo Ōtsutsuki, who used his Creation of All Things Technique to divide the Ten-Tails' chakra into nine separate bodies and giving each a name. Some time after being created, the Sage explained to the young tailed beasts that a link existed between them despite their separation. He also foretold of a day when they would be brought together again - though not as they were - and that at that time someone would emerge to show them what true power is.[3][4] In the anime, before his death, Hagoromo sent Chōmei to live in a temple built for the purpose of protecting it in a closed forest region covered by mosses.[5]
At some point in the past, Chōmei became affiliated with Takigakure, making it the only tailed beast known not to belong to Five Great Shinobi Countries. In the anime, this feat is attributed to the village's reputation of frequently producing skilled jōnin.[6] Decades later, the tailed beast would end up being sealed within Fū.
Chōmei seems to have a happy-go-lucky personality — which it seemingly shares with its jinchūriki as shown when it introduced itself to Naruto, referring to itself as Lucky Seven Chōmei (ラッキーセブン重明, Rakkī sebun Chōmei), which might be an allusion to the fact that it has seven tails and the number seven having long been seen as a lucky as well as a happy number. It also had a habit of using the word lucky in conversation, reflecting its personality.[7]

description_text:
Fantasy Football, is a tabletop game where two teams play an american football game against each other. The game is took in a fantasy world, home of legendary creatures like orcs, dwarves, elves, goblins etc.
Usually, 28-32mm miniatures are used for this game, representing players on the field. Goal of the game is the touchdown, who makes the most wins!
The game is played on a boxed playground.
Main rule is: no-hold-barred, in fact players can try to wound and mutilate opponents to get an easier touchdown by reducing the number of opponents.
Crosslances propose his own team, completely in digital, for 3D printing.
In our team you'll find crooked, genetically modified abominations, perfect to be played as Goblins or Putrids in a Fantasy football game.
From tentacles to tails, pustules to scars, in this team nothing is held back to instill fear in your opponent! They are as bad as they are ugly!
Miniatures are sculpted in ZBrush to obtain high quality details.

description_text:
This is a 3D Model sculpted in Blender inspired by the famous WhatsApp Sticker called Komo Dinosaur. This character has a charming yet violent face of a baby and looks cute, unlike some violent dinosaurs. This was sculpted using Blender on multi-res. I'm also including a low poly decimated version of this. It took a lot of hours of refinement to get this dinosaur to look how it does now. The files include one blend file in which the lighting and the environment is set up and another blend file in which you can get the dinosaur alone. 
This dinosaur model looks cute and can be used to put as a showcase piece in your archviz renders or maybe even on funny animations. But this is not rigged and is not meant to be used in animations as the main character since this is not in a T pose nor is rigged. Anyway, if you want to put it as a background piece in animations, it's gonna be absolutely fine and will make your scenes look stunningly colorful as well as cool.
The komo dino is a cute little dinosaur and his 3D model is no different. I strongly believe that someone will find this helpful and hence listing this for sale.

description_text:
A 6mm scale SciFi fast-attack light ground effect vehicle / hovercraft.
The Cricket L-GEV/HC (light ground effect vehicle / hovercraft) produced by Aluein Engineering, is an unusual hybrid design created for the specific planetological conditions of the great Western Plains of Dirwell. These vast sunken flatlands, remnants of ancient hemisphere-spanning oceans that have long since evaporated, are perfectly suited for swift hovercraft augmented with folding wings that exploit the airlift enhancement of the close ground effect. This gave rise to the light, single-seater Cricket hovercraft as a plains-runner scout.
Aptly named for the Terran insect species that rapidly adapted to Dirwell and helped early human colonisers to eco-form it, Crickets have been mass-manufactured now for close to a century. As such, they can be found in the employ of nearly every faction on Dirwell and are often fielded in large numbers for mutual support. This has led to some unusual, high-speed engagements between ‘swarms’ of Crickets on the Red Dust Plains north of Govone, especially between the Red Dust Security PMC and so-called Badlander bandits.

description_text:
The model is a game-ready low poly chicken easy to animate. 
The model is rigged.
---If you don't know what a chicken is---
The chicken (Gallus gallus domesticus) is a domesticated subspecies of the red junglefowl originally from Southeastern Asia. Rooster or is a term for an adult male bird, and a younger male may be called a cockerel. A male that has been castrated is a capon. An adult female bird is called a hen and a sexually immature female is called a pullet.
Originally raised for cockfighting or for special ceremonies, chickens were not kept for food until the Hellenistic period (4th–2nd centuries BC). Humans now keep chickens primarily as a source of food (consuming both their meat and eggs) and as pets.
Chickens are one of the most common and widespread domestic animals, with a total population of 23.7 billion as of 2018, up from more than 19 billion in 2011. There are more chickens in the world than any other bird. There are numerous cultural references to chickens – in myth, folklore and religion, and in language and literature.

description_text:
The Temple god statues are based on elements from the Thundercats cartoons, the statues were designed to recreate the most iconic and memorable aspects of the burial chamber of Mumm-Ra's tomb headquarters. Combining aspects of old and new series, all pieces are simple, but detailed 3D print ready models. These set pieces are a mix of high and low resolution geometry.  Statues have been split into bodies and heads. Boar, Crocodile, Bull/Ox, and Vulture statues have been included as STL and OBJ files. Supports are necessary to printing both, likely beneath skirt edges and head. The majority of the model areas should not need additonal support.
Update:Version 2 of the Boar / Bull / Crocodile heads have been added, refined to improve the clean output of teeth. The teeth should still capture the creep factor. Teeth are less sharp and a bit larger and longer, so that they support each other. The teeth have been recreated, adding thickness and interior support for the mouth. These changes should improve print quality and reduce the need for supports inside the mouth.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
Icelandic knight, late medieval / renaissance era.
This kit contains model parts allowing you to make a knight miniature with a number of signifiers relating it to Iceland.  See detailed parts list below.Recommended scale is 40 to 54mm scale. You can print the model at 28mm scale, but some details (particularly face and coat of arms) will suffer. Printing at sub-28mm scale may result in model parts being too delicate to print properly.All model parts are prescaled to roughly 54mm scale. Some minor assembly (using glue) is required. See image gallery and detailed list below for further information about model parts.
DETAILED LIST
Kit contains the following model parts:
1 Body and inscribed, stepped platform Armor is late 16th century Greenwich-style armor, with some fanciful touches of Maximillian/gothic style armor (especially the spiked poleyns). The weapon is a halberd. The pose and weapon are based on a statue depicting Ingolfr Arnarson (first recorded Norse permanent settler on Iceland). Its sculptor is Einar Jonsson, and to the best of my knowledge the statue is currently situated in a park in central Reykjavik. The text inscribed on the stepped platform are various names given to Iceland over the centuries. Decoration on shield is the coat of arms of Iceland between 1262-1500 AD.
1 Body  and inscribed stepped platform, version 2 Same as above, but different coat of arms on shield (the stockfish emblem used between 1500-1903 AD).
1 Body  separated from stairs Same as above, but separated from the stairs so you can use it in other contexts.
1 Body  separated from stairs, without shield Same as above, without the shield. This frees up the left hand to rest other shields/objects, like the sheathed sword included in this kit.
1 Shield, separate. One shield decorated with the coat of arm of Iceland 1262-1500 AD. The shield has arm straps. The straps may prevent you from gluing it to a miniature, and should be used primarily in situations when you want the back side of the shield to be visible.
1 Shield, separate. Same as above, but with the coat of arm of Iceland 1500-1903 AD.
3 Heads. 1 bareheaded. 1 wearing a peaked cap (face and cap based on the aforementioned statue by Einar Jonsson). 1 Wearing an enclosing sallet and bevor.
1 shipwreck . A beached and broken longship. The four figureheads are the four Landvaettir (guardian spirits) of Iceland - the Bull, Giant, Dragon and Eagle.  
1 Stairs, separated . The stepped and inscribed platform, separated from all other model parts.
2 Puffins . A common (and adorable) Icelandic seabird. 2 variants.
1 Sheathed Sword . 
1 Large Round base .
All model parts are included in a .rar archive as separate .stl files.
..............................

description_text:
All hail the Flying Spaghetti Monster. Ramen.
You will find here two models in one. The first is the flying spaghetti monster as a pendant, the second is the FSM in a cage.
The monster is 18mm wide and 17mm high. The shaghetti is 1mm thick. The eyelet fits a 2.5mm thick ribbon. Volume 426 cubic millimeters. 
The cage is 26mm wide and (without eyelet) 32mm high. The bars are 0.8mm thick. A 3mm ribbon fits through the eyelet. Volume: 1153 cubic millimeters. 
The model is best suited for 3D printing processes where no support structure is needed, but is technically suitable for all 3D printers. For metal casting, you will need to inquire with the manufacturer of your choice, you may need to scale the model up.  
As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.

description_text:
Collection of four dinosaur light switch cover plates (Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops, Apatosaurus, and Stegosaurus), ready for 3D print. Modeled in Autodesk Inventor and provided in multiple file formats.
Have a dinosaur fan in your family? Light up their room with this 3D-printable collection of dinosaur-themed wall decor. Fits standard-sized light switches (United States and other imperial regions).
Want to customize your cover plates? Native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files feature editable text so that you can include your child's name.
All cover plates are provided in three configurations - blank / no text (all formats), dinosaur name displayed (all formats), and editable text (native Autodesk Inventor 2012 files only).
Please note that this product includes the dinosaur cover plates only. Wall and light switch are shown for illustration purposes only.
Collection includes:
Tyrannosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.19 x 7.27 x 0.25 in
Triceratops light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.71 x 7.19 x 0.25 in
Apatosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.15 x 7.14 x 0.25 in
Stegosaurus light switch cover plate:
  - Physical dimensions: 3.89 x 6.96 x 0.25 in
Product includes:

  - 12 Autodesk Inventor 2012 models (IPT format) - all 4 dinosaurs in 3 configurations (blank / no text, dinosaur name displayed, and editable text)

  - 8 STP models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 SAT models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 IGS models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 STL models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 8 OBJ models - all 4 dinosaurs in 2 configurations (blank / no text and dinosaur name displayed)

  - 4 PDF drawings - all 4 dinosaurs

  - 1 Read Me text file (TXT format)

If you have any questions, either before or after purchasing this model collection, please feel free to contact me here on CGTrader and I will help in any way possible.

description_text:
When the Japan Coast Guard investigates an abandoned yacht in Tokyo Bay, its boat is destroyed, and the Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line is flooded. After seeing a viral video of the incident, Deputy Chief Cabinet Secretary Rando Yaguchi believes it was caused by a living creature, which is confirmed as news reports reveal its tail emerging from the ocean. Shortly thereafter, the creature moves inland, crawling through the Kamata district of Tokyo, leaving a path of death and destruction during a disorganized and chaotic evacuation. The creature quickly evolves into a bipedal form but overheats and returns to the sea.
The government officials focus on military strategy and civilian safety; Yaguchi is put in charge of a task force researching the creature. With high radiation readings from the creature's path, the task force realizes that it is energized by nuclear fission. The U.S. sends a special envoy, Kayoco Anne Patterson, who reveals that Goro Maki, a disgraced, anti-nuclear zoology professor, studied mutations caused by radioactive contamination, predicting the appearance of the creature. Maki was disbelieved by both American and Japanese scientific circles. The U.S. then prevented him from making his conclusions public. The abandoned yacht in Tokyo Bay belonged to Maki, who left his research notes, jumbled into a code, on the boat before disappearing.
The creature — named Godzilla, after Maki's research — reappears in its fourth form, twice its original size, making landfall near Kamakura. The Japan Self-Defense Forces mobilize but prove ineffective as Godzilla breaks through their defenses into Tokyo. The U.S. intervenes with a massively destructive airstrike plan, prompting the evacuation of civilians and government personnel. Godzilla is wounded with MOP bunker-buster bombs but responds with destructive atomic rays fired from its mouth and dorsal plates, destroying a helicopter carrying the prime minister, along with top government officials and incinerating large swaths of Tokyo. Depleting its energy, Godzilla enters a dormant state and becomes immobile.

description_text:
Low-poly bee skep for traditional bee keeping. A skep is a domed basket to house honey bees. European beekeepers switched from hollowed out logs to straw skeps around 800 AD. It’s made from all natural material like straw or hay bundles that are wrapped around a hollow dome. These bundles are stitched together with blackberry cane, which was split in half first. A slit of about 15 cm enables bees to enter and exit the structure.
*UPDATE 2022-04-25: *

  - made textures PBR

  - added .uasset-files for Unreal Engine 5 

The file includes:

  - Skep with a size of approx. 59 x 59 x 62 cm, with in- and outside

  - Cover scene is NOT included.

Further Information
Model is:

  - Fully mapped and textured with 2 tiling PBR-Textures (each 512x512).

  - In real world scale (meters).

  - Named.

description_text:
3D Model of the honey bee like insect.
Model was made using Blender 2.80.
The anatomy of the creature is made enitrely on the base of the anatomy of the honey bee. The colors of the insect is also based on the honey bee/wasp color scheme.
The diffuse/base color texture is 8192x8192 resolution and it is hand painted using brushes in the Blender. The model is UV mapped without overlapping UVs. The UVs are already carefuly checked and all are clean and are not overlapping each other. The mesh was carefully divided into few section by using seams. The materials of the skin/eyes/wings membrane are different and separated from each other. They are using base colors from the UV mapped base RGB diffuse 8192x8192 map. The bumpinness of the skin of the body, eyes nad wings membrane has been defined by using procedually generated separated voronol textures. The roughness of these materials was set using slider with different values for different parts of the body. The transparency of the wings membrane was defined by using transmission factor from the pirncipaled BDSF shader.
The mesh is designed for the easy subdivison as presented on the provided images of the mesh. It scales very well with the subdivision modifier.
Model is rigged, the skeleton is properly placed and designed, and each bone has properly attached weight values included in the vertex groups which define movement range of the parts of the mesh. 
The whole hair system is defined by the particle systems, the density of the particles  is defined by separated vertex weight groups painted on the model, so the hair appear only on the areas normally characteristic for the honey bee. The rendered hair are rendered as the objects and there are three separate types of hair objects which are used in the model. The hair objects are tapered at the end so the cross section is not constant.
For adding some color shadiness of the body and some other parts of the mesh the subsurface factors have been used.
Native format is .blend so if you want to use this model in the different software like 3ds max or game engine you will have to adjust your materials.

description_text:
Inspired by Laura, a colleague of mine, I present a new part of the biogrid collection. This beauty comes in two versions and two sizes. The first version is the body only and the second one has stretched wings. The lengt of the body from feeler to end of the small version is 28mm. The wings extend to a width of 56mm. The thinnest part has a diameter of 2mm and can therefore be easily printed on an fdm printer. I made a little lantern out of it. The big version is 57mm long and 113mm wide with wings. The rods have a diameter of 1mm. It is therefore still suitable for wax casting but needs a bit of extra attention on manufacturing.   
You can also scale the modle to your needs.
The rendering with the material examples shows in the upper left corner a layer thickness of 0.1mm as it could be created during 3D printing.
Suitable for 3D printing (such as sls, sla, fdm) and wax casting. As a trained goldsmith with years of experience in 3D design, I work with great care. If something does not fit, please feel free to contact me. And if you are happy with the model leave me a happy little comment.
If my designs inspire you contact me for your personal ideas.
